/-! ## Part 2 — route steps -/

namespace ProbeA

/-! ### R-PASS: the one-pass helper, derived from the real `catalog_trace_run` with the
constant return family (brief, H-pass) -/

theorem catalog_pass_contract {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} {S : Type*}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (F : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol S x) (D : Cfg k Symbol S x) (L : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ r < L, M.step (F r) = F (r + 1)) (hexit : M.step (F L) = D) (hD : M.step D = D)
    (P Q : Cfg k Symbol S x → Prop) (hP : ∀ r ≤ L, P (F r)) (hQ : ∀ r ≤ L, Q (F r))
    (hQD : Q D) :
    M.runFrom (F 0) (L + 1) = D ∧ (∀ t < L + 1, P (M.runFrom (F 0) t)) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ L + 1, Q (M.runFrom (F 0) t) := by
  have h : ∀ t, M.runFrom (F 0) t = if t ≤ L then F t else D := fun t => by
    simpa [catalogTrace] using
      catalog_trace_run M F (fun _ => D) D L hF hexit (fun _ _ => hD) hD hD t
  refine ⟨by rw [h]; simp, fun t ht => ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · rw [h, if_pos (by omega)]
    exact hP t (by omega)
  · rw [h]
    split_ifs with h1
    · exact hQ t h1
    · exact hQD

/-! ### R-ACT: every live anchor is stationary, by the public `step_of_inputMoveAction` at
`0` and `moveInputPos_zero` (the `hD` obligation) -/

example {Symbol State : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) (q : State) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = inputMoveAction 0 q) :
    M.step c = c := by
  rw [step_of_inputMoveAction M c 0 hq htr, moveInputPos_zero, ← hq]


/-! ### R-SEEK: a skip step along the one-pass family `F r` (the head of tape `i` at
`pos + r`, nothing else changed), discharged by the public `step_of_tapeAction_move` -/

example {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
    (skipTM k i).step
        { d with workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + r) } =
      { d with workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + (r + 1 : ℕ)) } := by
  have hs : ({ d with workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + r) } :
      Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x).workTapeSymbols i = some w[r] := by
    simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, hw r (by omega) (by omega), List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr]
  rw [step_of_tapeAction_move (skipTM k i) _ (q := .run) (q' := .run) i 0 .pos
    (by simpa using hstate) (by simp only [skipTM, hs])]
  apply Cfg.ext
  · simp [hstate]
  · simp
  · rfl
  · funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      simp only [Function.update_self, SignType.pos_eq_one, SignType.coe_one]
      push_cast
      ring
    · simp [hj]
  · rfl

/-! ### R-SCAN-STEP: the scan's forward write, discharged by the public `step_of_tapeAction_write` (the per-cell step
of the forward family; the backward family is the same shape with `.neg`) -/

example {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ)
    (a : A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) (γ : Γ)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a)) (hγ : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i) = some γ) :
    (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step d =
      { d with
        state := some (.fwd (δf a γ).1)
        workTapes := Function.update d.workTapes i
          (Function.update (d.workTapes i) (d.workTapePos i) (some (δf a γ).2))
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + 1) } := by
  have hs : d.workTapeSymbols i = some γ := hγ
  rw [step_of_tapeAction_write (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) d (q' := .fwd (δf a γ).1) i 0
    (some (δf a γ).2) .pos hstate (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
  simp [SignType.pos_eq_one]

/-! ### R-CMP: the canonical compare from the framed row, `fst ≠ snd` only

`compareTM_run` has no `fst ≠ snd` hypothesis (the aliased case is part of its
statement), so it cannot cite `compareTM_run_ofCfg` alone: the brief has both canonical
compare rows cite the generalized private trace instead. This example checks the
specialization step (`Cfg.ofWords` satisfies the two delimited-word hypotheses, and the
framed finish is the canonical seam) on the non-aliased branch. -/

example (k : ℕ) (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (w : Fin k → List Bool)
    {x : List Bool} :
    ∃ T ≤ 2 * min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2,
      (∀ t < T, ∀ v : Bool, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state
          ≠ some (FlagPhase.done v)) ∧
      (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T =
        Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done (decide (w fst = w snd))) w := by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hrun, hcut, -⟩ := compareTM_run_ofCfg fst snd hne (w fst) (w snd)
    (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) .run w) rfl
    (by intro p _ _; simp [Cfg.ofWords]) (by intro p _ _; simp [Cfg.ofWords])
  exact ⟨2 * δ + 2, by omega, hcut, hrun.trans rfl⟩

/-- R-CMP: `catalog_compare_stop`'s body, verbatim, at a generic alphabet with decidable
equality (the in-place generalization is types-only). -/
example {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] (u v : List Symbol) :
    ∃ d ≤ min u.length v.length,
      (∀ r < d, ∃ b, u[r]? = some b ∧ v[r]? = some b) ∧
      (¬∃ b, u[d]? = some b ∧ v[d]? = some b) ∧
      (u[d]? = v[d]? ↔ u = v) := by
  induction u generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    cases v with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
    | cons b v => exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  | cons a u ih =>
    cases v with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
    | cons b v =>
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst b
        obtain ⟨d, hd, hp, hs, he⟩ := ih v
        refine ⟨d + 1, by simpa using hd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro r hr
          cases r with
          | zero => exact ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
          | succ r => simpa using hp r (by omega)
        · simpa using hs
        · simpa using he
      · refine ⟨0, by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [eq_comm] using hab
        · simp [hab]

/-! ### R-SCAN: the pure Mealy facts the scan trace and the five identities rest on -/

/-- The identity step transduces nothing. -/
theorem mealyRun_keep {A Γ : Type*} (a : A) (l : List Γ) : mealyRun scanKeep a l = (a, l) := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons γ l ih => simp [mealyRun, scanKeep, ih]

/-- With the identity return, a scan is its forward pass (four of the five identities
reduce to a `mealyRun` induction through this). -/
theorem scanResult_keep {A Γ : Type*} (δf : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult δf scanKeep a₀ w = mealyRun δf a₀ w := by
  simp [scanResult, mealyRun_keep]

/-- Mealy runs split over an append (the per-cell step of both passes of the trace). -/
theorem mealyRun_append {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List Γ) :
    mealyRun δ a (l₁ ++ l₂) =
      ((mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).1,
        (mealyRun δ a l₁).2 ++ (mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).2) := by
  induction l₁ generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [mealyRun]
  | cons γ l ih => simp [mealyRun, ih]

/-- Mealy runs preserve length (the scan's rewritten interval is the word interval). -/
theorem mealyRun_length {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l : List Γ) :
    (mealyRun δ a l).2.length = l.length := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons γ l ih => simp [mealyRun, ih]

/-- The one list identity `scanResult_shiftLeft` needs beyond `scanResult_shiftRight`:
the right shift of the reversed word, reversed back, is the left shift. -/
theorem shiftLeft_list {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    (List.zipWith set w.reverse (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get)).reverse =
      List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀]) := by
  cases w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a w =>
    -- the reversed right shift reads one mark too many; `zipWith` drops it
    have h1 : List.zipWith set (a :: w).reverse (b₀ :: (a :: w).reverse.map get) =
        List.zipWith set (w.reverse ++ [a]) (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) := by
      have h := List.zipWith_append (f := set) (l₁ := w.reverse ++ [a]) (l₁' := [])
        (l₂ := b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) (l₂' := [get a]) (by simp)
      simp only [List.append_nil, List.zipWith_nil_left] at h
      rw [← h]
      simp
    -- both lists now have length `|w| + 1`, so reversal commutes with `zipWith`
    have h2 : List.zipWith set (w.reverse ++ [a]) (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) =
        (List.zipWith set (a :: w) (w.map get ++ [b₀])).reverse := by
      rw [List.reverse_zipWith (by simp)]
      simp
    rw [h1, h2, List.reverse_reverse]
    rfl

/-! ### R-FIELD: the end blanks of a table, from the public layout facts (the seek-end
exit and the seek-start left end) -/

example {Γ : Type*} (ws : List (List Γ)) (hne : ws ≠ []) (p : ℤ)
    (hp : (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ) - 1 ≤ p) : fieldsTape ws p = none := by
  have h := length_joinFields_add_one ws hne
  unfold fieldsTape
  split_ifs with h0
  · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
    rfl
  · rfl


/-! ### R-SEAM: both branches of `seamCompTM₂_run_ofCfg` from the promoted prefix lemma and
the right lockstep (here through `seamCompTM_run_ofCfg` at `h₂ := rfl`; in Seam the private
`seamComp_right` is the same lockstep) -/

section seam
variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol S₀ S₁ S₂ : Type*} {x : List Symbol} [DecidableEq S₀] [DecidableEq S₁]
  (M₀ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₀) (e₁ e₂ : S₀) (he : e₁ ≠ e₂)
  (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (entry₁ : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry₂ : S₂)
  {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₀ x} {T₀ : ℕ}
  (h₀ : M₀.runFrom c₀ T₀ = c₁)
  (hcut : ∀ t < T₀, (M₀.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₁ ∧ (M₀.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₂)
include he h₀ hcut

/-- Branch `e₂`: the inner composite reaches `Sum.inl e₂` at `T₀`, and the outer seam
dispatches. -/
example (h2 : c₁.state = some e₂) (t : ℕ) :
    (seamCompTM₂ M₀ e₁ e₂ M₁ entry₁ M₂ entry₂).runFrom
        ((c₀.mapState Sum.inl).mapState Sum.inl) (T₀ + 1 + t) =
      (M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₂) t).mapState Sum.inr := by
  have hcut₁ : ∀ s < T₀, (M₀.runFrom c₀ s).state ≠ some e₁ := fun s hs => (hcut s hs).1
  have hin : (seamCompTM M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) T₀ =
      c₁.mapState Sum.inl := by
    rw [seamCompTM_runFrom_left M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁ hcut₁ T₀ le_rfl, h₀]
  have hcutO : ∀ s < T₀, ((seamCompTM M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁).runFrom
      (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) s).state ≠ some (Sum.inl e₂) := by
    intro s hs h
    rw [seamCompTM_runFrom_left M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁ hcut₁ s hs.le] at h
    exact (hcut s hs).2 (by simpa [Cfg.mapState] using h)
  have hmap : ((c₁.mapState (Sum.inl : S₀ → S₀ ⊕ S₁)).mapState (fun _ => entry₂) :
      Cfg k Symbol S₂ x) = c₁.mapState (fun _ => entry₂) := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [Cfg.mapState, h2]
  have h := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg (seamCompTM M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁) (Sum.inl e₂) M₂ entry₂ hin
    (by simp [Cfg.mapState, h2]) hcutO
    (rfl : M₂.runFrom ((c₁.mapState (Sum.inl : S₀ → S₀ ⊕ S₁)).mapState fun _ => entry₂) t = _)
  rw [hmap] at h
  exact h

/-- Branch `e₁`: the outer seam never meets `Sum.inl e₂`, so its left prefix is the inner
composite, which the right lockstep evaluates. -/
example (h1 : c₁.state = some e₁) (t : ℕ) :
    (seamCompTM₂ M₀ e₁ e₂ M₁ entry₁ M₂ entry₂).runFrom
        ((c₀.mapState Sum.inl).mapState Sum.inl) (T₀ + 1 + t) =
      ((M₁.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₁) t).mapState Sum.inr).mapState Sum.inl := by
  have hcut₁ : ∀ s < T₀, (M₀.runFrom c₀ s).state ≠ some e₁ := fun s hs => (hcut s hs).1
  have hinner : ∀ s, (seamCompTM M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl)
      (T₀ + 1 + s) = (M₁.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₁) s).mapState Sum.inr :=
    fun s => seamCompTM_run_ofCfg M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁ h₀ h1 hcut₁ rfl
  have hcutO : ∀ s < T₀ + 1 + t, ((seamCompTM M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁).runFrom
      (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) s).state ≠ some (Sum.inl e₂) := by
    intro s hs h
    by_cases hle : s ≤ T₀
    · rw [seamCompTM_runFrom_left M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁ hcut₁ s hle] at h
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s T₀ with hlt | hge
      · exact (hcut s hlt).2 (by simpa [Cfg.mapState] using h)
      · obtain rfl : s = T₀ := by omega
        rw [h₀] at h
        exact he (by simpa [Cfg.mapState, h1] using h)
    · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, s = T₀ + 1 + r := ⟨s - (T₀ + 1), by omega⟩
      rw [hinner r] at h
      simp [Cfg.mapState] at h
  have h := seamCompTM_runFrom_left (seamCompTM M₀ e₁ M₁ entry₁) (Sum.inl e₂) M₂ entry₂
    hcutO (T₀ + 1 + t) le_rfl
  rw [hinner t] at h
  exact h

end seam

end ProbeA

@fieldsTape_field : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} (fs : List (List Γ)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < fs.length) (p : ℤ),
  -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑fs[j].length → fieldsTape fs (↑(fieldOffset fs j) + p) = FinTM.bufferTape fs[j] p
@compareTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k),
  fst ≠ snd →
    ∀ (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x),
      d.state = some FlagPhase.run →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑u.length → d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) →
          (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑v.length → d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) →
            ∃ δ ≤ min u.length v.length,
              MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * δ + 2) =
                  { state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))), inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
                    workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
                (∀ t < 2 * δ + 2, ∀ (b : Bool), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
                  ∀ (j : Fin k),
                    ∀ t ≤ 2 * δ + 2,
                      if j = fst ∨ j = snd then
                        (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                          Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑δ)
                      else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@skipTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x),
  d.state = some SeekPhase.run →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), 0 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (w.length + 1) =
          { state := some SeekPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ↑w.length + 1), output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < w.length + 1, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SeekPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ w.length + 1,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length + 1)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@skipBackTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (u : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x),
  d.state = some SeekPhase.run →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑u.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - ↑u.length - 1 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (u.length + 3) =
          { state := some SeekPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - ↑u.length - 1), output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < u.length + 3, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SeekPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ u.length + 3,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - ↑u.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@seekEndTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (ws : List (List Symbol)),
  ws ≠ [] →
    (∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ []) →
      ∀ (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x),
        d.state = some SeekPhase.run →
          (∀ (p : ℤ), 0 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑(fieldOffset ws ws.length) → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = fieldsTape ws p) →
            MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1) =
                { state := some SeekPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
                  workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ↑(fieldOffset ws ws.length)),
                  output := d.output } ∧
              (∀ t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SeekPhase.done) ∧
                ∀ (j : Fin k),
                  ∀ t ≤ fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1,
                    if j = i then
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                        Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + ↑(fieldOffset ws ws.length))
                    else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@seekStartTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (ws : List (List Symbol)),
  (∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ []) →
    ∀ (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x),
      d.state = some SeekPhase.run →
        d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i) ≠ none →
          (∀ (p : ℤ),
              -2 ≤ p →
                p < ↑(fieldOffset ws ws.length) →
                  d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - ↑(fieldOffset ws ws.length) + p) = fieldsTape ws p) →
            MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4) =
                { state := some SeekPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
                  workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - ↑(fieldOffset ws ws.length)),
                  output := d.output } ∧
              (∀ t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SeekPhase.done) ∧
                ∀ (j : Fin k),
                  ∀ t ≤ fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4,
                    if j = i then
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                        Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - ↑(fieldOffset ws ws.length) - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
                    else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@scanTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A)
  (w : List Γ) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x),
  d.state = some (ScanPhase.fwd a₀) →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
          { state := some (ScanPhase.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1), inputPos := d.inputPos,
            workTapes := fun j q =>
              if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j q,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ (a : A), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (ScanPhase.done a)) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@scanResult_fold : ∀ {A : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanFold δ) scanKeep a₀ w = (List.foldl δ a₀ w, w)
@scanResult_map : ∀ {A : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (f : Γ → Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanMap f) scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, List.map f w)
@scanResult_shiftRight : ∀ {B : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanShift get set) scanKeep b₀ w =
    ((List.map get w).getLast?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (b₀ :: List.map get w))
@scanResult_shiftLeft : ∀ {B : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult scanKeep (scanShift get set) b₀ w =
    ((List.map get w).head?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (List.map get w.tail ++ [b₀]))
@scanResult_carry : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanCarry top next) scanKeep true w =
    (w.all top,
      List.map next (List.takeWhile top w) ++ List.map next (List.take 1 (List.dropWhile top w)) ++
        List.drop 1 (List.dropWhile top w))
@seamCompTM₂_run_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {S₀ : Type u_4} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₀] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S₁] (M₀ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₀) (e₁ e₂ : S₀),
  e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    ∀ (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (entry₁ : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry₂ : S₂)
      {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₀ x} {T₀ : ℕ},
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₀ = c₁ →
        (∀ t < T₀, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₁ ∧ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₂) →
          (c₁.state = some e₁ →
              ∀ (t : ℕ),
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀)) (T₀ + 1 + t) =
                  Cfg.mapState Sum.inl
                    (Cfg.mapState Sum.inr (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry₁) c₁) t))) ∧
            (c₁.state = some e₂ →
              ∀ (t : ℕ),
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀)) (T₀ + 1 + t) =
                  Cfg.mapState Sum.inr (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry₂) c₁) t))
@catalogTrace : {k : ℕ} →
  {Symbol : Type u_1} →
    {x : List Symbol} →

#check @List.foldl_append
#check @List.take_length
#check @List.getElem?_eq_getElem
-- the R3 framed rows whose families are the duplication hazard (for comparison only)
#check @copyTM_run_ofCfg
#check @clearTM_run_ofCfg
#check @transferTM_run_ofCfg
#check @scanTM_run_ofCfg
-- the downstream consumer of `writeAdvTM_run_ofCfg`
#check @expandTM
#check @expandTM_run_ofCfg

-- The promoted names are visible in this olean tree: expected `true, true`.
open Lean Elab Command in
#eval show CommandElabM Unit from do
  let env ← getEnv
  logInfo m!"catalogTrace visible: {env.contains `Turing.catalogTrace}, \
    catalog_trace_run visible: {env.contains `Turing.catalog_trace_run}"

/-! ## Part 3 — `inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg` as a trace instance -/

section Fold

variable {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}

/-- Forward family: after `r` steps the state is the fold of the first `r` symbols and
the input head is at `r + 1` (`min` makes the family total; only `r ≤ |x|` is used). -/
def probeFoldF (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) (r : ℕ) :
    Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x :=
  { d with state := some (.fwd ((x.take r).foldl δ a₀))
           inputPos := ⟨min r x.length + 1, by omega⟩ }

/-- Return family, indexed by the input position `r`, counted down to the left blank. -/
def probeFoldR (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) (r : ℕ) :
    Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x :=
  { d with state := some (.bwd (x.foldl δ a₀))
           inputPos := ⟨min r x.length, by omega⟩ }

/-- Exit: the target's finish configuration. -/
def probeFoldD (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) :
    Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x :=
  { d with state := some (.done (x.foldl δ a₀)) }

theorem probe_fold_F0 (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    probeFoldF δ a₀ d 0 = d := by
  apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [probeFoldF, hstate, hin]

/-- **The forward step equation** (`hF`, at every `r < |x|`; the required check). -/
theorem probe_fold_hF (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r < x.length) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).step (probeFoldF δ a₀ d r) = probeFoldF δ a₀ d (r + 1) := by
  have hs : (probeFoldF δ a₀ d r).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
    inputSymbolInner r (by simp [probeFoldF]; omega) hr
  change ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).tr (.fwd _) _ _).apply _ = _
  simp only [inputFoldTM, hs]
  apply Cfg.ext
  case state =>
    simp only [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldF]
    rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr, List.foldl_append]
    rfl
  case inputPos =>
    simp only [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldF]
    rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
    omega
  all_goals simp [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldF]

theorem probe_fold_hturn (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).step (probeFoldF δ a₀ d x.length) =
      probeFoldR δ a₀ d x.length := by
  have hs : (probeFoldF δ a₀ d x.length).inputSymbol = none := by
    simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, probeFoldF]
  change ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).tr (.fwd _) _ _).apply _ = _
  simp only [inputFoldTM, hs]
  apply Cfg.ext
  case state => simp [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldF, probeFoldR]
  case inputPos =>
    simp only [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldF, probeFoldR]
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
    simp
  all_goals simp [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldF, probeFoldR]

theorem probe_fold_hR (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r < x.length) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).step (probeFoldR δ a₀ d (r + 1)) = probeFoldR δ a₀ d r := by
  have hs : (probeFoldR δ a₀ d (r + 1)).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
    inputSymbolInner r (by simp [probeFoldR]; omega) hr
  change ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).tr (.bwd _) _ _).apply _ = _
  simp only [inputFoldTM, hs]
  apply Cfg.ext
  case inputPos =>
    simp only [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldR]
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
    simp
    omega
  all_goals simp [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldR]

theorem probe_fold_hentry (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).step (probeFoldR δ a₀ d 0) = probeFoldD δ a₀ d := by
  have hs : (probeFoldR δ a₀ d 0).inputSymbol = none := by
    simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, probeFoldR]
  change ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).tr (.bwd _) _ _).apply _ = _
  simp only [inputFoldTM, hs]
  apply Cfg.ext
  case inputPos =>
    simp only [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldR, probeFoldD, hin]
    rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp)]
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  all_goals simp [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeFoldR, probeFoldD]

theorem probe_fold_hD (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).step (probeFoldD δ a₀ d) = probeFoldD δ a₀ d := by
  apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [MultiTapeTM.step, inputFoldTM, Action.apply, inputMoveAction,
    probeFoldD]

/-- The input fold's run is the two-pass trace at every time. -/
theorem probe_fold_trace (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) (t : ℕ) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (probeFoldF δ a₀ d) (probeFoldR δ a₀ d) (probeFoldD δ a₀ d) x.length t := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← probe_fold_F0 δ a₀ d hstate hin]
  exact catalog_trace_run _ _ _ _ _ (probe_fold_hF δ a₀ d) (probe_fold_hturn δ a₀ d)
    (probe_fold_hR δ a₀ d) (probe_fold_hentry δ a₀ d hin) (probe_fold_hD δ a₀ d) t

/-- `inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg` (statement copied from `Build/Scan.lean:265`) from the trace. -/
theorem probe_inputFold_contract (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
        { d with state := some (.done (x.foldl δ a₀)) } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, ∀ a,
        ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2 →
        ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [probe_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp [catalogTrace, probeFoldD, show ¬2 * x.length + 2 ≤ x.length by omega]
  · intro t ht a
    rw [probe_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [probeFoldF, probeFoldR] <;> omega
  · intro j t _
    rw [probe_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [probeFoldF, probeFoldR, probeFoldD]

end Fold

/-! ## Part 4 — the shared write family, the two writers and the copier -/

section Write

variable {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}

/-- The framed write family shared by the three writing rows: `r` cells of `w` written
from the head of tape `i`, that head advanced by `r`, control `q`, input position `p`,
and everything else as in `d`. -/
def probeWriteCfg {S : Type*} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol S x) (q : S)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol S x :=
  { d with state := some q
           inputPos := p
           workTapes := fun j z =>
             if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (r : ℤ)
               then FinTM.bufferTape w (z - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j z
           workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) else 0 }

/-- The one write step shared by `writeConstTM`, `writeAdvTM` and `inputCopyTM`: writing
`w[r]` and moving right extends the written prefix by one cell. -/
theorem probe_write_step {S : Type*} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol S x)
    (q q' : S) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (inp : SignType) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
    (tapeAction i inp (some (some w[r])) .pos q').apply (probeWriteCfg i w d q p r) =
      probeWriteCfg i w d q' (moveInputPos p inp) (r + 1) := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  case workTapes =>
    simp only [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeWriteCfg]
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simp only [if_true, true_and]
      exact catalog_write_take _ _ w r hr
    · simp [hj]
  case workTapePos =>
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeWriteCfg, hj] <;> omega
  all_goals simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeWriteCfg]

/-! ### `writeConstTM` -/

def probeWcF (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x)
    (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x :=
  probeWriteCfg i w₀ d (.wr ⟨min r w₀.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos r

def probeWcR (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x)
    (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x :=
  { probeWriteCfg i w₀ d (.bk ⟨min r w₀.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos w₀.length with
      workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) else 0 }

def probeWcD (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x) :
    Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x :=
  { d with state := some .done
           workTapes := (probeWcF i w₀ d w₀.length).workTapes }

theorem probe_wc_trace (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.wr 0)) (t : ℕ) :
    (writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (probeWcF i w₀ d) (probeWcR i w₀ d) (probeWcD i w₀ d) w₀.length t := by
  have h0 : probeWcF i w₀ d 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext
    case state => simp [probeWcF, probeWriteCfg, hstate]
    case workTapes =>
      funext j z
      simp [probeWcF, probeWriteCfg]
    all_goals simp [probeWcF, probeWriteCfg]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h0]
  apply catalog_trace_run
  · -- forward: one write step
    intro r hr
    change ((writeConstTM k i w₀).tr (.wr _) _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [writeConstTM, probeWcF]
    rw [dif_pos (show min r w₀.length < w₀.length by omega)]
    simp only [show min r w₀.length = r by omega, show min (r + 1) w₀.length = r + 1 by omega]
    rw [probe_write_step i w₀ d _ _ _ _ r hr, moveInputPos_zero]
  · -- turn: stationary, into the walk back
    change ((writeConstTM k i w₀).tr (.wr _) _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [writeConstTM]
    rw [dif_neg (show ¬ min w₀.length w₀.length < w₀.length by omega)]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeWcF, probeWcR, probeWriteCfg]
  · -- return: one left move
    intro r hr
    change ((writeConstTM k i w₀).tr (.bk _) _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [writeConstTM]
    rw [if_neg (show ¬ min (r + 1) w₀.length = 0 by omega)]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case state => simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeWcR, probeWriteCfg]; omega
    case workTapes =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeWcR, probeWriteCfg, hj]
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeWcR, probeWriteCfg, hj] <;>
        omega
    all_goals simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeWcR, probeWriteCfg]
  · -- entry: stationary, into `done`
    change ((writeConstTM k i w₀).tr (.bk _) _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [writeConstTM]
    rw [if_pos (show min 0 w₀.length = 0 by omega)]
    apply Cfg.ext <;>
      simp [Action.apply, inputMoveAction, probeWcR, probeWcD, probeWcF, probeWriteCfg]
  · apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [MultiTapeTM.step, writeConstTM, Action.apply, inputMoveAction,
      probeWcD]

/-- `writeConstTM_run_ofCfg` (statement copied from `Build/Scan.lean:115`). -/
theorem probe_writeConst_contract (i : Fin k)
    (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.wr 0)) :
    (writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d (2 * w₀.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w₀.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape w₀ (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w₀.length + 2, ((writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w₀.length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + (w₀.length : ℤ))
        else ((writeConstTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [probe_wc_trace i w₀ d hstate]
    simp [catalogTrace, probeWcD, probeWcF, probeWriteCfg,
      show ¬2 * w₀.length + 2 ≤ w₀.length by omega]
  · intro t ht
    rw [probe_wc_trace i w₀ d hstate]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [probeWcF, probeWcR, probeWcD, probeWriteCfg] <;> omega
  · intro j t ht
    rw [probe_wc_trace i w₀ d hstate]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [probeWcF, probeWcR, probeWcD, probeWriteCfg, Finset.mem_Icc] <;>
      omega

/-! ### `writeAdvTM` (cyclic: one forward induction, no trace instance) -/

def probeWaF (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w₀.length + 1)) x)
    (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w₀.length + 1)) x :=
  probeWriteCfg i w₀ d ⟨min r w₀.length, by omega⟩ d.inputPos r

theorem probe_wa_run (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w₀.length + 1)) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some 0) :
    ∀ r ≤ w₀.length, (writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d r = probeWaF i w₀ d r := by
  intro r hr
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    apply Cfg.ext
    case state => simp [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg, hstate]
    case workTapes =>
      funext j z
      simp [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg]
    all_goals simp [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg]
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    change ((writeAdvTM k i w₀).tr _ _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [writeAdvTM, probeWaF]
    rw [dif_pos (show min r w₀.length < w₀.length by omega)]
    simp only [show min r w₀.length = r by omega, show min (r + 1) w₀.length = r + 1 by omega]
    rw [probe_write_step i w₀ d _ _ _ _ r (by omega), moveInputPos_zero]

/-- `writeAdvTM_run_ofCfg` (statement copied from `Build/Scan.lean:162`). -/
theorem probe_writeAdv_contract (i : Fin k)
    (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w₀.length + 1)) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some 0) :
    (writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d (w₀.length + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some 0
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w₀.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape w₀ (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i + (w₀.length : ℤ)) } ∧
      (∀ t, 0 < t → t < w₀.length + 1 → ((writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w₀.length + 1 →
        if j = i then
          ((writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + (w₀.length : ℤ))
        else ((writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  -- the last, stationary step returns state `|w₀|` to `0`
  have hlast : (writeAdvTM k i w₀).runFrom d (w₀.length + 1) =
      { probeWaF i w₀ d w₀.length with state := some 0 } := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', probe_wa_run i w₀ d hstate _ le_rfl]
    change ((writeAdvTM k i w₀).tr _ _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [writeAdvTM, probeWaF, probeWriteCfg]
    rw [dif_neg (show ¬ min w₀.length w₀.length < w₀.length by omega)]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [Action.apply, inputMoveAction]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hlast]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j; simp [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg]
      · simp [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg, hj]
    all_goals simp [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg]
  · intro t ht0 ht
    rw [probe_wa_run i w₀ d hstate t (by omega)]
    simp only [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero]
    omega
  · intro j t ht
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t (w₀.length + 1) with h | h
    · rw [probe_wa_run i w₀ d hstate t (by omega)]
      split_ifs with hj <;> simp [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg, hj, Finset.mem_Icc] <;> omega
    · rw [show t = w₀.length + 1 by omega, hlast]
      split_ifs with hj <;> simp [probeWaF, probeWriteCfg, hj, Finset.mem_Icc]

/-! ### `inputCopyTM` -/

def probeIcF (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x :=
  probeWriteCfg i x d .sweep ⟨min r x.length + 1, by omega⟩ r

def probeIcR (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (r : ℕ) : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x :=
  { probeWriteCfg i x d .rewind ⟨min r x.length, by omega⟩ x.length with
      workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) - 1 else 0 }

def probeIcD (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x :=
  { d with state := some .done
           workTapes := (probeIcF i d x.length).workTapes }

theorem probe_ic_trace (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some .sweep) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) (t : ℕ) :
    (inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (probeIcF i d) (probeIcR i d) (probeIcD i d) x.length t := by
  have h0 : probeIcF i d 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos => rw [hin]; apply Fin.ext; simp [probeIcF, probeWriteCfg]
    case workTapes =>
      funext j z
      simp [probeIcF, probeWriteCfg]
    all_goals simp [probeIcF, probeWriteCfg, hstate]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h0]
  apply catalog_trace_run
  · -- forward: one lockstep write step
    intro r hr
    have hs : (probeIcF i d r).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
      inputSymbolInner r (by simp [probeIcF, probeWriteCfg]; omega) hr
    change ((inputCopyTM k i).tr .sweep _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [inputCopyTM, hs]
    rw [probeIcF, probe_write_step i x d _ _ _ _ r hr]
    congr 1
    rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
    omega
  · -- turn at the right end marker: both heads left
    have hs : (probeIcF i d x.length).inputSymbol = none := by
      simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, probeIcF, probeWriteCfg]
    change ((inputCopyTM k i).tr .sweep _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [inputCopyTM, hs]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcF, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg]
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
      simp
    case workTapes =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcF, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg, hj]
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;>
        simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcF, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg, hj] <;> omega
    all_goals simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcF, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg]
  · -- return: both heads left
    intro r hr
    have hs : (probeIcR i d (r + 1)).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
      inputSymbolInner r (by simp [probeIcR, probeWriteCfg]; omega) hr
    change ((inputCopyTM k i).tr .rewind _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [inputCopyTM, hs]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg]
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
      simp
      omega
    case workTapes =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg, hj]
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg, hj] <;>
        omega
    all_goals simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg]
  · -- entry at the left end marker: both heads right, into `done`
    have hs : (probeIcR i d 0).inputSymbol = none := by
      simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, probeIcR, probeWriteCfg]
    change ((inputCopyTM k i).tr .rewind _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [inputCopyTM, hs]
    apply Cfg.ext
    case inputPos =>
      simp only [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcR, probeIcD, probeWriteCfg, hin]
      rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp)]
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
    case workTapes =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;>
        simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcR, probeIcD, probeIcF, probeWriteCfg, hj]
    case workTapePos =>
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcR, probeIcD, probeWriteCfg, hj]
    all_goals simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, probeIcR, probeIcD, probeIcF, probeWriteCfg]
  · apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [MultiTapeTM.step, inputCopyTM, Action.apply, inputMoveAction,
      probeIcD]

/-- `inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg` (statement copied from `Build/Scan.lean:215`). -/
theorem probe_inputCopy_contract (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .sweep) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    (inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (x.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape x (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, ((inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (x.length : ℤ))
        else ((inputCopyTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [probe_ic_trace i d hstate hin]
    simp [catalogTrace, probeIcD, probeIcF, probeWriteCfg,
      show ¬2 * x.length + 2 ≤ x.length by omega]
  · intro t ht
    rw [probe_ic_trace i d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [probeIcF, probeIcR, probeIcD, probeWriteCfg] <;> omega
  · intro j t ht
    rw [probe_ic_trace i d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [probeIcF, probeIcR, probeIcD, probeWriteCfg, Finset.mem_Icc] <;>
      omega

end Write

/-! ## Part 6 — the steps as citations of the pre-issue step lemmas

The shared write step at the `M.step` level, a writer's forward step and turn, the copier's
turn, and the fold's forward step, each citing `Turing.step_of_tapeAction_move`,
`Turing.step_of_tapeAction_write` or `Turing.step_of_inputMoveAction` (`5afed90b`) without
unfolding `Action.apply`. -/

section Write6

variable {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}

/-- the shared write step, stated at `M.step` and proved through the step lemma -/
theorem probe_write_step2 {S : Type*} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (i : Fin k)
    (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol S x) (q q' : S) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (inp : SignType) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length)
    (htr : M.tr q (probeWriteCfg i w d q p r).inputSymbol
        (probeWriteCfg i w d q p r).workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp (some (some w[r])) .pos q') :
    M.step (probeWriteCfg i w d q p r) = probeWriteCfg i w d q' (moveInputPos p inp) (r + 1) := by
  rw [step_of_tapeAction_write M _ i inp _ .pos rfl htr]
  apply Cfg.ext
  case workTapes =>
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simpa [probeWriteCfg] using catalog_write_take (d.workTapes i) (d.workTapePos i) w r hr
    · simp [probeWriteCfg, hj]
  case workTapePos =>
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [probeWriteCfg, hj, Function.update_apply, SignType.cast] <;> omega
  all_goals simp [probeWriteCfg]

-- writeConst hF through the shared step
example (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w₀.length) :
    (writeConstTM k i w₀).step
        (probeWriteCfg i w₀ d (.wr ⟨min r w₀.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos r) =
      probeWriteCfg i w₀ d (.wr ⟨min (r + 1) w₀.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos (r + 1) := by
  rw [← moveInputPos_zero d.inputPos]
  conv_rhs => rw [moveInputPos_zero]
  have := probe_write_step2 (writeConstTM k i w₀) i w₀ d (.wr ⟨min r w₀.length, by omega⟩)
    (.wr ⟨min (r + 1) w₀.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos 0 r hr (by
      simp only [writeConstTM]
      rw [dif_pos (show min r w₀.length < w₀.length by omega)]
      simp only [show min r w₀.length = r by omega]
      congr 2
      apply Fin.ext; simp; omega)
  rw [moveInputPos_zero] at this ⊢
  exact this

-- writeConst hturn through step_of_inputMoveAction
example (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x) :
    (writeConstTM k i w₀).step
        (probeWriteCfg i w₀ d (.wr ⟨min w₀.length w₀.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos w₀.length) =
      probeWriteCfg i w₀ d (.bk ⟨min w₀.length w₀.length, by omega⟩) d.inputPos w₀.length := by
  rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 rfl (q' := .bk ⟨min w₀.length w₀.length, by omega⟩) (by
    simp only [writeConstTM]
    rw [dif_neg (show ¬ min w₀.length w₀.length < w₀.length by omega)]
    simp)]
  simp [probeWriteCfg]

-- inputCopy hturn through step_of_tapeAction_move
example (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) :
    (inputCopyTM k i).step (probeWriteCfg i x d .sweep ⟨min x.length x.length + 1, by omega⟩ x.length) =
      { probeWriteCfg i x d .rewind ⟨min x.length x.length, by omega⟩ x.length with
          workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (x.length : ℤ) - 1 else 0 } := by
  have hs : (probeWriteCfg i x d .sweep ⟨min x.length x.length + 1, by omega⟩ x.length).inputSymbol
      = none := by simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, probeWriteCfg]
  rw [step_of_tapeAction_move _ _ i (-1) .neg rfl (q' := .rewind) (by simp only [inputCopyTM, hs])]
  apply Cfg.ext
  case inputPos =>
    simp only [probeWriteCfg]
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
    simp
  case workTapePos =>
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [probeWriteCfg, hj, Function.update_apply] <;> omega
  all_goals simp [probeWriteCfg]

end Write6

section Fold6

variable {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}

-- inputFold hF through step_of_inputMoveAction
example (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < x.length) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).step (probeFoldF δ a₀ d r) = probeFoldF δ a₀ d (r + 1) := by
  have hs : (probeFoldF δ a₀ d r).inputSymbol = some x[r] :=
    inputSymbolInner r (by simp [probeFoldF]; omega) hr
  rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 1 rfl (q' := .fwd (δ ((x.take r).foldl δ a₀) x[r]))
    (by simp only [inputFoldTM, hs])]
  apply Cfg.ext
  case state =>
    simp only [probeFoldF]
    rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr, List.foldl_append]
    rfl
  case inputPos =>
    simp only [probeFoldF]
    rw [← SignType.pos_eq_one, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
    omega
  all_goals simp [probeFoldF]
end Fold6

## ===== audits/evidence/s12-8/S128FillBProbe.out =====

@tapeAction : {k : ℕ} →
  {Symbol : Type u_1} →
    {State : Type u_2} → Fin k → SignType → Option (Option Symbol) → SignType → State → Action k Symbol State
@inputMoveAction : {k : ℕ} → {Symbol : Type u_1} → {State : Type u_2} → SignType → State → Action k Symbol State
@catalogTrace : {k : ℕ} →
  {Symbol : Type u_1} →
    {x : List Symbol} →
      {S : Type u_2} → (ℕ → Cfg k Symbol S x) → (ℕ → Cfg k Symbol S x) → Cfg k Symbol S x → ℕ → ℕ → Cfg k Symbol S x
@catalog_trace_run : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type u_1} {x : List Symbol} {S : Type u_2} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S)
  (F R : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol S x) (D : Cfg k Symbol S x) (L : ℕ),
  (∀ r < L, MultiTapeTM.step (F r) = F (r + 1)) →
    MultiTapeTM.step (F L) = R L →
      (∀ r < L, MultiTapeTM.step (R (r + 1)) = R r) →
        MultiTapeTM.step (R 0) = D →
          MultiTapeTM.step D = D → ∀ (t : ℕ), MultiTapeTM.runFrom (F 0) t = catalogTrace F R D L t
@catalog_write_take : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} (f : ℤ → Option Symbol) (a : ℤ) (w : List Symbol) (r : ℕ)
  (hr : r < w.length),
  Function.update (fun q => if a ≤ q ∧ q < a + ↑r then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - a) else f q) (a + ↑r) (some w[r]) =
    fun q => if a ≤ q ∧ q < a + ↑(r + 1) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - a) else f q
@step_of_tapeAction_move : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k) (inp m : SignType),
  c.state = some q →
    M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp none m q' →
      MultiTapeTM.step c =
        { state := some q', inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp, workTapes := c.workTapes,
          workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + ↑m), output := c.output }
@step_of_tapeAction_write : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k) (inp : SignType)
  (s : Option Symbol) (m : SignType),
  c.state = some q →
    M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp (some s) m q' →
      MultiTapeTM.step c =
        { state := some q', inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp,
          workTapes := Function.update c.workTapes i (Function.update (c.workTapes i) (c.workTapePos i) s),
          workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + ↑m), output := c.output }
@step_of_inputMoveAction : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (inp : SignType),
  c.state = some q →
    M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = inputMoveAction inp q' →
      MultiTapeTM.step c =
        { state := some q', inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp, workTapes := c.workTapes,
          workTapePos := c.workTapePos, output := c.output }
SweepPhase : Type
ScanPhase : Type → Type
WritePhase : ℕ → Type
@writeConstTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → (w₀ : List Symbol) → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length)
@writeAdvTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → (w₀ : List Symbol) → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (Fin (w₀.length + 1))
@inputCopyTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase
@inputFoldTM : {Γ : Type u_1} → {A : Type} → (k : ℕ) → (A → Γ → A) → A → MultiTapeTM k Γ (ScanPhase A)
@writeConstTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x),
  d.state = some (WritePhase.wr 0) →
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w₀.length + 2) =
        { state := some WritePhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w₀.length then
              FinTM.bufferTape w₀ (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q,
          workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w₀.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some WritePhase.done) ∧
        ∀ (j : Fin k),
          ∀ t ≤ 2 * w₀.length + 2,
            if j = i then
              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w₀.length)
            else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@writeAdvTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol (Fin (w₀.length + 1)) x),
  d.state = some 0 →
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (w₀.length + 1) =
        { state := some 0, inputPos := d.inputPos,
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w₀.length then
              FinTM.bufferTape w₀ (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q,
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ↑w₀.length), output := d.output } ∧
      (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → t < w₀.length + 1 → (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some 0) ∧
        ∀ (j : Fin k),
          ∀ t ≤ w₀.length + 1,
            if j = i then
              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w₀.length)
            else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
  d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
    d.inputPos = 1 →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
          { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
            workTapes := fun j q =>
              if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑x.length then
                FinTM.bufferTape x (q - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j q,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑x.length)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A)
  (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x),
  d.state = some (ScanPhase.fwd a₀) →
    d.inputPos = 1 →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
          { state := some (ScanPhase.done (List.foldl δ a₀ x)), inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, ∀ (a : A), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (ScanPhase.done a)) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k), ∀ t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@MultiTapeTM.step : {k : ℕ} →
  {State : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} →
      {input : List Symbol} → {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} → Cfg k Symbol State input → Cfg k Symbol State input
@MultiTapeTM.runFrom : {k : ℕ} →
  {State : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} →
      {input : List Symbol} →
        {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} → Cfg k Symbol State input → ℕ → Cfg k Symbol State input
@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}
  {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input}, MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg 0 = cfg
@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step' : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}
  {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} {t : ℕ},
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg (t + 1) = MultiTapeTM.step (MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg t)
@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}
  {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (a b : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg (a + b) = MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg a) b
@Action.apply : {k : ℕ} →
  {State : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} →
      {input : List Symbol} → Action k Symbol State → Cfg k Symbol State input → Cfg k Symbol State input
@Action.apply_workTapes : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}
  (a : Action k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (i : Fin k),
  (a.apply c).workTapes i =
    Function.update (c.workTapes i) (c.workTapePos i) ((a.workTapes i).1.getD (c.workTapeSymbols i))
@Cfg.ext : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol} {x y : Cfg k Symbol State input},
  x.state = y.state →
    x.inputPos = y.inputPos → x.workTapes = y.workTapes → x.workTapePos = y.workTapePos → x.output = y.output → x = y
@Cfg.inputSymbol : {k : ℕ} →
  {State : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → {input : List Symbol} → Cfg k Symbol State input → Option Symbol
@Cfg.workTapeSymbols : {k : ℕ} →
  {State : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → {input : List Symbol} → Cfg k Symbol State input → Fin k → Option Symbol
@inputSymbolInner : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}
  {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} (p : ℕ),
  ↑cfg.inputPos = 1 + p → ∀ (h₂ : p < input.length), cfg.inputSymbol = some input[p]
@moveInputPos : {n : ℕ} → Fin (n + 2) → SignType → Fin (n + 2)
@moveInputPos_zero : ∀ {n : ℕ} (pos : Fin (n + 2)), moveInputPos pos 0 = pos
@moveInputPos_leftBoundary : ∀ {n : ℕ}, moveInputPos 0 (-1) = 0
@moveInputPos_rightBoundary : ∀ {n : ℕ}, moveInputPos ⟨n + 1, ⋯⟩ 1 = ⟨n + 1, ⋯⟩
@moveInputPos_neg_of_ne_left : ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)), p ≠ 0 → moveInputPos p SignType.neg = ⟨↑p - 1, ⋯⟩
@moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right : ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (h : ↑p ≠ n + 1), moveInputPos p SignType.pos = ⟨↑p + 1, ⋯⟩
@FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val : ∀ {n : ℕ} (pos : Fin (n + 2)), ↑(moveInputPos pos SignType.neg) = ↑pos - 1
@FinTM.bufferTape : {Symbol : Type u_1} → List Symbol → ℤ → Option Symbol
@FinTM.bufferTape_nat : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} (w : List Symbol) (i : ℕ), FinTM.bufferTape w ↑i = w[i]?
@FinTM.bufferTape_left : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} (w : List Symbol), FinTM.bufferTape w (-1) = none
SignType.pos_eq_one : SignType.pos = 1
SignType.neg_eq_neg_one : SignType.neg = -1
@List.take_succ : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i : ℕ}, List.take (i + 1) l = List.take i l ++ l[i]?.toList
@List.foldl_append : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : β → α → β} {b : β} {l l' : List α},
  List.foldl f b (l ++ l') = List.foldl f (List.foldl f b l) l'
@List.take_length : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α}, List.take l.length l = l
@List.getElem?_eq_getElem : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i : ℕ} (h : i < l.length), l[i]? = some l[i]
@copyTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k),
  src ≠ dst →
    ∀ (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
      d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = src ∨ j = dst then
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                      Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@clearTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),

@expandTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (pat : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (pat.length + 1)) x),

        ∀ (d : ℕ),

            MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)

                counterLoopCfg (some CounterLoopState.done)

                        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate d pat).flatten (q - c.workTapePos j)
                      else c.workTapes j q,

                      some CounterLoopState.done ∧

                      some CounterLoopState.escape) ∧

                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                            t).workTapePos
