/-! ## Part 2 — route steps -/

namespace S128ProbeCPre2

/-! ### R-SEEK-LIFT: a lifted `Bool` module on dedicated digit tapes of a rich bank

Round-1 note 32 / round-2 note 31: isolate the dedicated digit tapes by R1; the rich record
tapes are R1's frame. The transport is two rewrites. -/

example {K : ℕ} {Γ : Type} [DecidableEq Γ] (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {S : Type}
    (R : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (ι : Fin 2 ↪ Fin (K + 1))
    (tapes : Fin (K + 1) → ℤ → Option Γ) (heads : Fin (K + 1) → ℤ) (pre : List Γ)
    {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 2 Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    (embedEmitTM ι (R.liftSymbols e)).runFrom (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre (c.liftSymbols e)) t =
      embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre ((R.runFrom c t).liftSymbols e) := by
  rw [embedEmitTM_runFrom, MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols_runFrom]

/-- The seek's components, lifted along the record digits (the record step's `R8.5b` call). -/
example (Q T : Type) [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] : True := by
  obtain ⟨S, _, _, R, _entry, _exit, _C, _hR⟩ := exists_inputSeekTM
  let _R' : MultiTapeTM 2 (RecSym Q T) S := R.liftSymbols (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)
  trivial

/-- **Restriction to a dedicated digit bank** (the start of every lifted phase of the record
step). A rich host configuration whose selected tapes hold only digits and blanks *is* the R1
transport of the lift of its decoded `Bool` restriction, with the host's other tapes, heads and
output as the frame. Proved from the public API (`embedEmitCfg_selected_*`, `embedEmitTM_frame`
at time `0`, `decodeBool_apply`); a candidate shared lemma for `Build/Embed` or `SymbolLift`. -/
theorem probeRestrict {K m : ℕ} {Γ : Type} [DecidableEq Γ] (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {S H : Type}
    (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin K) {x : List Bool} (D : Cfg K Γ H (x.map e)) (s : S) (h₀ : H)
    (hD : D.state = some h₀)
    (hdig : ∀ i p γ, D.workTapes (ι i) p = some γ → ∃ b, γ = e b) :
    D.mapState (fun _ => s) =
      embedEmitCfg ι D.workTapes D.workTapePos D.output
        (Cfg.liftSymbols e (⟨some s, Fin.cast (by simp) D.inputPos,
          fun i p => (D.workTapes (ι i) p).bind (decodeBool e),
          fun i => D.workTapePos (ι i), []⟩ : Cfg m Bool S x)) := by
  set c : Cfg m Bool S x := ⟨some s, Fin.cast (by simp) D.inputPos,
    fun i p => (D.workTapes (ι i) p).bind (decodeBool e), fun i => D.workTapePos (ι i), []⟩
  have hframe := fun (j : Fin K) (hj : j ∉ Set.range ι) =>
    (embedEmitTM_frame ι
      (⟨s, fun _ _ _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩⟩ : MultiTapeTM m Γ S)
      D.workTapes D.workTapePos D.output (c.liftSymbols e) 0).1 j hj
  apply Cfg.ext
  · simp [Cfg.mapState, hD, embedEmitCfg, Cfg.liftSymbols, c]
  · simp [Cfg.mapState, embedEmitCfg, Cfg.liftSymbols, c]
  · funext j
    by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hj
      rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_tape]
      funext p
      simp only [Cfg.mapState, Cfg.liftSymbols, c]
      cases hcell : D.workTapes (ι i) p with
      | none => rfl
      | some γ =>
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hdig i p γ hcell
        simp
    · simpa [Cfg.mapState] using (hframe j hj).1.symm
  · funext j
    by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hj
      rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_pos]
      rfl
    · simpa [Cfg.mapState] using (hframe j hj).2.symm
  · simp [Cfg.mapState, embedEmitCfg, Cfg.liftSymbols, c]

/-- A lifted delimited word is the delimited word of the lift: the landed `FinTM.bufferTape_map`. -/
example {Γ : Type} (e : Bool ↪ Γ) (w : List Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (w.map e) p = (FinTM.bufferTape w p).map e :=
  FinTM.bufferTape_map e w p

/-! ### R-SEEK-BODY: the counter-loop round "input head right" (round-2 note 4)

One state, one step, cyclic: the round shape `counterLoopTM_run_done` needs, with `τ := 1`. -/

/-- Probe sketch of the seek's private round body. -/
def probeSeekBody : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool Unit where
  q₀ := ()
  tr := fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 1 ()

theorem probeSeekBody_orbit_state {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Unit x)
    (hc : c.state = some ()) (r : ℕ) :
    (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r).state = some () := by
  induction r with
  | zero => simpa [counterLoopOrbit] using hc
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [counterLoopOrbit, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    change (probeSeekBody.step (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r)).state = _
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, ih]
    rfl

theorem probeSeekBody_orbit_input {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Unit x)
    (hc : c.state = some ()) (r : ℕ) (hr : c.inputPos.val + r ≤ x.length + 1) :
    (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r).inputPos.val = c.inputPos.val + r := by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [counterLoopOrbit]
  | succ r ih =>
    have ih' := ih (by omega)
    rw [counterLoopOrbit, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    change (probeSeekBody.step (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r)).inputPos.val = _
    have hs := probeSeekBody_orbit_state c hc r
    generalize counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r = o at ih' hs ⊢
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hs]
    change (moveInputPos o.inputPos SignType.pos).val = _
    rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by omega)]
    simp only
    omega

/-- The round hypotheses of `counterLoopTM_run_done` for the seek body, at every round. -/
theorem probeSeekBody_hround {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Unit x) (hc : c.state = some ())
    (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ r < d,
      (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r).state = some () ∧
      0 < (fun _ => 1 : Cfg 1 Bool Unit x → ℕ) (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r) ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < (fun _ => 1 : Cfg 1 Bool Unit x → ℕ)
          (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r) →
        ∃ s, (probeSeekBody.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c r) u).state =
          some s ∧ s ≠ () ∧ (none : Option Unit) ≠ some s) ∧
      (counterLoopOrbit probeSeekBody (fun _ => 1) c (r + 1)).state = some () := by
  intro r _
  refine ⟨probeSeekBody_orbit_state c hc r, Nat.one_pos, ?_, probeSeekBody_orbit_state c hc _⟩
  intro u hu hu'
  simp only at hu'
  omega

/-- The seek's countdown phase, from the rewound input (position `0`), lands at `p`: the
`counterLoopTM_run_done` call with the body above. -/
example {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Unit x) (hc : c.state = some ()) (h0 : c.inputPos.val = 0)
    (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → ct (cp + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = p) (hpx : p ≤ x.length + 1) :
    ((counterLoopTM probeSeekBody () none).runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp)
        (∑ _r ∈ Finset.range p, 1 + counterOverhead w (p + 1))).inputPos.val = p := by
  have h := (counterLoopTM_run_done probeSeekBody () none (fun _ => 1) c w ct cp hw p hp
    (probeSeekBody_hround c hc p) _ rfl).1
  rw [h]
  have := probeSeekBody_orbit_input c hc p (by omega)
  simpa [counterLoopCfg, embedEmitCfg, Cfg.mapState, h0] using this

/-! ### R-SEEK-REWIND: `timed_rewind` on the seek's private rewind table (round-1 minor 2)

`timed_rewind` stops at position `1` within `pos + 2`; one further left move reaches `0`. -/

/-- Probe sketch of the rewind phases. -/
inductive ProbeRw where
  | start | scan | left | done
deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- Probe sketch of the seek's private rewind table, in `timed_rewind`'s required shape. -/
def probeRewindTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM k Bool ProbeRw where
  q₀ := .start
  tr := fun q inp _ =>
    match q with
    | .start => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .scan)
    | .scan =>
      match inp with
      | some _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .scan)
      | none => FinTM.controlAction .pos (some .left)
    | .left => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .done)
    | .done => FinTM.controlAction 0 (some .done)

example {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool ProbeRw x) (hs : c.state = some .start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      (probeRewindTM k).runFrom c r = {c with state := some .left, inputPos := 1} :=
  FinTM.timed_rewind (probeRewindTM k) .start .scan (some .left) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl) c hs

/-- The landed `FinTM.rewind_heads` on the same table: the run and the fixed work heads. -/
example {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool ProbeRw x) (hs : c.state = some .start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      (probeRewindTM k).runFrom c r = {c with state := some .left, inputPos := 1} ∧
      ∀ u ≤ r, ((probeRewindTM k).runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos :=
  FinTM.rewind_heads (probeRewindTM k) .start .scan (some .left) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl) c hs

/-- The extra left move after `timed_rewind`: from position `1` to `0`, into the stationary exit. -/
example {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool ProbeRw x) :
    ((probeRewindTM k).runFrom
        ({c with state := some ProbeRw.left, inputPos := 1} : Cfg k Bool ProbeRw x) 1).inputPos.val
          = 0 ∧
      ((probeRewindTM k).runFrom
        ({c with state := some ProbeRw.left, inputPos := 1} : Cfg k Bool ProbeRw x) 1).state =
          some ProbeRw.done := by
  refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
  change (moveInputPos (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) .neg).val = 0
  rw [FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
  simp

/-! ### R-SEEK-ASSEMBLY: the four phases glue by R2 at two tapes

Copy `w` from tape `0` to tape `1`; rewind; count down on tape `1` (the counter loop's last
tape, `Fin.last 1`) moving the input right; clear tape `1`. The `1 + 1` tapes of
`counterLoopTM` unify with the `2` of the R3 rows, and the state type is finite. -/

/-- Probe sketch of the seek module's machine. -/
def probeSeekTM : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool
    (((SweepPhase ⊕ ProbeRw) ⊕ CounterLoopState Unit) ⊕ SweepPhase) :=
  seamCompTM
    (seamCompTM (seamCompTM (copyTM 2 0 1) SweepPhase.done (probeRewindTM 2) ProbeRw.start)
      (Sum.inr ProbeRw.done) (counterLoopTM probeSeekBody () none) (.dec .run))
    (Sum.inr CounterLoopState.done) (clearTM 2 1) SweepPhase.sweep

example : Fintype (((SweepPhase ⊕ ProbeRw) ⊕ CounterLoopState Unit) ⊕ SweepPhase) ×
    DecidableEq (((SweepPhase ⊕ ProbeRw) ⊕ CounterLoopState Unit) ⊕ SweepPhase) :=
  ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

/-- The counter loop's counter is tape `1` of the seek's bank. -/
example : (Fin.last 1 : Fin 2) = 1 := rfl

/-! ### R-CALL: `exists_inputCallTM` = `inputCopyTM` + `exists_installCallTM` (round-1 minor 3,
round-2 note 8) -/

/-- The copier from the blank seam ends at the install call's entry seam. Cites the sorried
`inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg` (stream B). -/
theorem probeCopy_seam (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (x : List Bool) :
    (inputCopyTM k ⟨0, hk⟩).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep (fun _ => []))
        (2 * x.length + 2) =
      Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (stateWord k x) := by
  rw [(inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg ⟨0, hk⟩ _ rfl rfl).1]
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext j q
    simp only [Cfg.ofWords, stateWord]
    by_cases hj : j = ⟨0, hk⟩
    · subst hj
      simp only [true_and, zero_add, sub_zero, FinTM.bufferTape_nil, if_true]
      unfold FinTM.bufferTape
      by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ q <;> by_cases h1 : q < (x.length : ℤ) <;>
        simp [h0, h1]
    · have hj' : (j : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h)
      simp [hj, hj']
  · rfl
  · rfl

/-- The `entry ≠ exit` branch: the composite run of the input call, by
`seamCompTM_run_ofCfg` and `seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg`. -/
example (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    True := by
  obtain ⟨C, entry, exit, c, hk, hC⟩ := FinTM.exists_installCallTM M f T hM
  have key : ∀ x : List Bool, entry ≠ exit → ∃ t,
      (seamCompTM (inputCopyTM C.k ⟨0, hk⟩) SweepPhase.done C.tm entry).runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (Sum.inl SweepPhase.sweep) (fun _ => []))
          (2 * x.length + 2 + 1 + t) =
        Cfg.ofWords (Sum.inr exit) (stateWord C.k (f x)) ∧
      ∀ u < 2 * x.length + 2 + 1 + t,
        ((seamCompTM (inputCopyTM C.k ⟨0, hk⟩) SweepPhase.done C.tm entry).runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (Sum.inl SweepPhase.sweep) (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠
          some (Sum.inr exit) := by
    intro x hne
    obtain ⟨t, _ht, _hpos, hfirst, hrun⟩ := hC x x
    have hcopy := probeCopy_seam C.k hk x
    have hcut := (inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg (x := x) ⟨0, hk⟩
      (Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.sweep (fun _ => [])) rfl rfl).2.1
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact seamCompTM_run_ofCfg (inputCopyTM C.k ⟨0, hk⟩) SweepPhase.done C.tm entry hcopy rfl
        hcut hrun
    · refine seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg (inputCopyTM C.k ⟨0, hk⟩) SweepPhase.done C.tm entry
        exit hcopy rfl hcut hrun rfl ?_
      intro u hu
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos u with h0 | hpos
      · subst h0
        simpa [Cfg.ofWords, Cfg.mapState] using hne
      · exact hfirst u hpos hu
  trivial

/-- The `entry = exit` branch: the release adapter supplies the time-zero cut. -/
example (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    True := by
  obtain ⟨C, entry, exit, c, hk, hC⟩ := FinTM.exists_installCallTM M f T hM
  have key : ∀ x : List Bool, entry = exit → ∃ t,
      (seamReleaseTM C.tm exit).runFrom
          ((Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k x)).mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ())
          t = (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) exit (stateWord C.k (f x))).mapState Sum.inr ∧
      ∀ u < t, ((seamReleaseTM C.tm exit).runFrom
          ((Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k x)).mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ())
          u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr exit) := by
    intro x he
    obtain ⟨t, _ht, hpos, hfirst, hrun⟩ := hC x x
    subst he
    exact ⟨t, seamReleaseTM_firstReturn C.tm entry rfl hpos hrun rfl hfirst⟩
  trivial

/-! ### R-PHASE: the landed phase host (`phaseHostTM`, `phaseHostTM_run`, Seam) -/

/-- The landed phase lemma, at the probe's instance shape. -/
example {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i))
    (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ}
    (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ) (h : (M i).runFrom c T = c') (s' : Ph i)
    (hs' : c'.state = some s') (q' : Σ i, Ph i) (hred : red i s' = some q')
    (hguard : ∀ u < T, ∀ s, ((M i).runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) :
    (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) (T + 1) =
      c'.mapState (fun _ => q') :=
  (phaseHostTM_run M q0 red i c c' T h s' hs' q' hred hguard).2

/-! ### R-STEP data facts -/

/-- A halted source steps to itself and emits nothing, so `hupd` keeps the tag. -/
example {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool Q x)
    (h : c.state = none) : M.step c = c ∧ M.outputSymbol c = none :=
  ⟨MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt h, MultiTapeTM.outputSymbol_of_halt h⟩

/-- Every input position has a code at the position width. -/
theorem probe_pos_lt (n : ℕ) : n + 1 < 2 ^ posWidth n := by
  unfold posWidth
  rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  exact Nat.lt_size_self _

/-- The one-digit width is exactly the empty input (round-2 note 3: the `|x| = 0` branch is
detected from `F1`'s width, with no native movement). -/
theorem probe_posWidth_eq_one (n : ℕ) : posWidth n = 1 ↔ n = 0 := by
  unfold posWidth
  rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    have : 1 < Nat.size (n + 1) := Nat.lt_size.mpr (by omega)
    omega
  · rintro rfl
    simp [Nat.size_one]

/-- The position field's value is the position (the seek's `hp` premise): `binDigits` is the
little-endian code below `2 ^ w`. Induction on `w` with `Nat.testBit_add_one`. -/
theorem probe_ofDigits_binDigits (w v : ℕ) (hv : v < 2 ^ w) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((binDigits w v).map Bool.toNat) = v := by
  induction w generalizing v with
  | zero => simp at hv; subst hv; simp [binDigits]
  | succ w ih =>
    have hrange : binDigits (w + 1) v = v.testBit 0 :: binDigits w (v / 2) := by
      simp only [binDigits, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map]
      congr 1
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro i _
      simp [Nat.testBit_add_one]
    rw [hrange, List.map_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, ih (v / 2) (by rw [pow_succ] at hv; omega)]
    rw [Nat.testBit_zero]
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one v with h | h <;> simp [h] <;> omega

/-- `RecordAt` plus `fieldsTape_field` (stream A) frames field `j` of the record at its offset,
given that the field lies inside the layout (a private span lemma of the fill). -/
example {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg K Γ S x) (r : Fin K) (fs : List (List Γ))
    (hrec : RecordAt d r fs) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < fs.length)
    (hspan : fieldOffset fs j + fs[j].length ≤ (joinFields fs).length) :
    ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (fs[j].length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes r ((d.workTapePos r + fieldOffset fs j) + p) = FinTM.bufferTape fs[j] p := by
  intro p hp1 hp2
  rw [← fieldsTape_field fs j hj p hp1 hp2, add_assoc]
  exact hrec _ (by omega) (by omega)

/-- The record alphabet's phase types are finite where the record rows need them. -/
example (Q T : Type) [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T] :
    Fintype (ScanPhase (Option (Option Q))) × Fintype (ScanPhase (Option T)) ×
      Fintype (CounterLoopState Unit) × DecidableEq (RecSym Q T) × Fintype (RecSym Q T) :=
  ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

/-- Record equality, field `0`: the framed compare applies at the two heads (the row's first
phase; `fieldOffset fs 0 = 0`). Cites the sorried `compareTM_run_ofCfg` and
`fieldsTape_field` (stream A). -/
example {Γ : Type} [DecidableEq Γ] {x : List Γ} (fs gs : List (List Γ)) (hf : 0 < fs.length)
    (hg : 0 < gs.length) (d : Cfg 2 Γ FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run)
    (hrf : RecordAt d 0 fs) (hrg : RecordAt d 1 gs)
    (hsf : fs[0].length ≤ (joinFields fs).length) (hsg : gs[0].length ≤ (joinFields gs).length) :
    ∃ δ ≤ min fs[0].length gs[0].length,
      (compareTM 2 0 1).runFrom d (2 * δ + 2) =
        { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (fs[0] = gs[0]))) } := by
  have hfr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (fs[0].length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape fs[0] p := by
    intro p h1 h2
    have := fieldsTape_field fs 0 hf p h1 h2
    simp only [fieldOffset, List.take_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, Nat.cast_zero,
      zero_add] at this
    rw [← this]
    exact hrf p h1 (by omega)
  have hgr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (gs[0].length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 1 (d.workTapePos 1 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape gs[0] p := by
    intro p h1 h2
    have := fieldsTape_field gs 0 hg p h1 h2
    simp only [fieldOffset, List.take_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, Nat.cast_zero,
      zero_add] at this
    rw [← this]
    exact hrg p h1 (by omega)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hrun, -, -⟩ := compareTM_run_ofCfg 0 1 (by decide) fs[0] gs[0] d hstate hfr hgr
  exact ⟨δ, hδ, hrun⟩

/-! ### R-SEEK-LAYOUT: the counter-loop host layout from the public R1 API

`counterLoopCfg` is `embedEmitCfg Fin.castSuccEmb` with the counter as the frame. A consumer that
starts the loop from an arbitrary two-tape configuration must identify it with a
`counterLoopCfg`. CounterLoop's `counter_cfg_eq` does this but is `private`; the same identity
follows from `embedEmitTM_frame` at time `0` and `embedEmitCfg_selected_*`, as below. **The fill
should request `counter_cfg_eq`'s promotion rather than keep a second proof** (duplication
hazard, see the dossier). -/

theorem probeCounterLayout {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (q : Option (CounterLoopState S))
    (c : Cfg 1 Bool S x) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ) :
    (counterLoopCfg q c ct cp).workTapes (Fin.castSucc 0) = c.workTapes 0 ∧
      (counterLoopCfg q c ct cp).workTapes (Fin.last 1) = ct ∧
      (counterLoopCfg q c ct cp).workTapePos (Fin.castSucc 0) = c.workTapePos 0 ∧
      (counterLoopCfg q c ct cp).workTapePos (Fin.last 1) = cp ∧
      (counterLoopCfg q c ct cp).inputPos = c.inputPos ∧
      (counterLoopCfg q c ct cp).output = c.output ∧ (counterLoopCfg q c ct cp).state = q := by
  rw [counter_cfg_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ <;> simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.lastCases_last]

/-! ### R-STEP-SAVE: saving the native input position (round-2 note 3)

The record step must restore an arbitrary host input position `pos`. A counter-loop round "if
the input is blank, exit; else move left" (zero body tapes; the host's only tape is the fuel
counter) escapes at round `q` from position `q`, leaving the counter at `value - (q + 1)`;
complementing gives `q + 1`. The two blank boundaries are told apart beforehand by a one-step
right probe (`|x| ≥ 1`); `|x| = 0` is detected from `F1`'s width and needs no movement. -/

/-- Probe sketch of the save loop's round body: anchor `false`, exit `true`. -/
def probeSaveBody : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool Bool where
  q₀ := false
  tr := fun q inp _ =>
    match q, inp with
    | false, some _ => inputMoveAction (-1) false
    | false, none => inputMoveAction 0 true
    | true, _ => inputMoveAction 0 true

theorem probeSaveBody_orbit {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 0 Bool Bool x) (hc : c.state = some false)
    (hq : c.inputPos.val ≤ x.length) (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ c.inputPos.val) :
    (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c r).state = some false ∧
      (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c r).inputPos.val = c.inputPos.val - r := by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact ⟨by simpa [counterLoopOrbit] using hc, by simp [counterLoopOrbit]⟩
  | succ r ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hp⟩ := ih (by omega)
    rw [counterLoopOrbit, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    change (probeSaveBody.step (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c r)).state = _ ∧
      (probeSaveBody.step (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c r)).inputPos.val = _
    generalize counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c r = o at hs hp ⊢
    have hsym : o.inputSymbol = some x[o.inputPos.val - 1] :=
      inputSymbolInner (o.inputPos.val - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hs]
    rw [hsym]
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    change (moveInputPos o.inputPos SignType.neg).val = _
    rw [FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
    omega

/-- At round `q` the head is on the left end marker, and the round exits. -/
theorem probeSaveBody_exit {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 0 Bool Bool x) (hc : c.state = some false)
    (hq : c.inputPos.val ≤ x.length) :
    (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c (c.inputPos.val + 1)).state = some true ∧
      (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c (c.inputPos.val + 1)).inputPos.val = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hp⟩ := probeSaveBody_orbit c hc hq c.inputPos.val le_rfl
  rw [counterLoopOrbit, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
  change (probeSaveBody.step (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c c.inputPos.val)).state
      = _ ∧
    (probeSaveBody.step (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c c.inputPos.val)).inputPos.val
      = _
  generalize counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c c.inputPos.val = o at hs hp ⊢
  have h0 : o.inputPos = 0 := Fin.ext (by simp only [Fin.val_zero]; omega)
  have hsym : o.inputSymbol = none := by
    unfold Cfg.inputSymbol
    rw [dif_pos h0]
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hs]
  rw [hsym]
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  change (moveInputPos o.inputPos 0).val = 0
  rw [moveInputPos_zero, h0]
  rfl

/-- The save loop: `counterLoopTM_run_escape` with the body above escapes at round `q = pos`,
the head on `0`, the fuel counter at `counterWord w (q + 1)`. -/
example {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 0 Bool Bool x) (hc : c.state = some false)
    (hq : c.inputPos.val ≤ x.length) (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → ct (cp + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q)
    (hfuel : c.inputPos.val < Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)) :
    (counterLoopTM probeSaveBody false (some true)).runFrom
        (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp)
        (∑ _r ∈ Finset.range (c.inputPos.val + 1), 1 + counterOverhead w (c.inputPos.val + 1)) =
      counterLoopCfg (some .escape)
        (counterLoopOrbit probeSaveBody (fun _ => 1) c (c.inputPos.val + 1))
        (fun q => if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + (w.length : ℤ)
          then FinTM.bufferTape (counterWord w (c.inputPos.val + 1)) (q - cp) else ct q) cp := by
  refine (counterLoopTM_run_escape probeSaveBody false true (by decide) (fun _ => 1) c w ct cp hw
    c.inputPos.val hfuel ?_ (probeSaveBody_exit c hc hq).1 _ rfl).1
  intro r hr
  refine ⟨(probeSaveBody_orbit c hc hq r hr).1, Nat.one_pos, ?_⟩
  intro u hu hu'
  simp only at hu'
  omega

/-- Complementing a counter word: values add to `2 ^ |u| - 1`, so the complement of
`counterWord w (q + 1)` (value `2 ^ |w| - 1 - (q + 1)` from an all-`true` fuel `w`) has value
`q + 1`, the restore seek's target. -/
theorem probe_ofDigits_not (u : List Bool) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((u.map not).map Bool.toNat) + Nat.ofDigits 2 (u.map Bool.toNat) =
      2 ^ u.length - 1 := by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b u ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, List.length_cons, pow_succ]
    have h2 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ u.length := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    cases b <;>
      simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.toNat_true, Bool.toNat_false] <;> omega

end S128ProbeCPre2

@cfgRecord_inj : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) {c d : Cfg k Bool Q x} {τ τ' : T},
  Cfg.InWindow s c →
    Cfg.InWindow s d →
      (cfgRecord s c τ = cfgRecord s d τ' ↔
        (c.state = d.state ∧ c.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ c.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ c.workTapePos = d.workTapePos) ∧
          τ = τ')
@recordValid_iff : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} (n s : ℕ) (fs : List (List (RecSym Q T))),
  RecordValid k n s Q T fs ↔
    fs.length = k + 3 ∧
      (∃ q, fs[0]? = some [RecSym.st q]) ∧
        (∃ v ≤ n + 1, fs[1]? = some (List.map RecSym.digit (binDigits (posWidth n) v))) ∧
          (∀ (i : Fin k),
              ∃ cs,
                ∃ m < 2 * s + 1,
                  fs[↑i + 2]? =
                    some (List.map (fun j => RecSym.cell (cs j) (decide (j = m))) (List.range (2 * s + 1)))) ∧
            ∃ τ, fs[k + 2]? = some [RecSym.tag τ]
@exists_recordStepTM : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T),
  (∀ (τ : T), upd τ none = τ) →
    ∃ K P x x R entry yes no C,
      yes ≠ no ∧
        ∀ {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T),
          Cfg.InWindow s c →
            ∀ (d : Cfg (K + 1) (RecSym Q T) P (List.map (⇑(RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) x)),
              d.state = some entry →
                RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ) →
                  (∀ (j : Fin (K + 1)), j ≠ 0 → ∀ (p : ℤ), d.workTapes j p = none) →
                    ∃ t ≤ C * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + x.length + 1),
                      (∀ u < t,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some yes ∧ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some no) ∧
                        (∀ u ≤ t,
                            ∀ (j : Fin (K + 1)),
                              |(MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
                                ↑(C * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1))) ∧
                          (Cfg.InWindow s (MultiTapeTM.step c) →
                              MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t =
                                { state := some yes, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                                  workTapes := fun j q =>
                                    if
                                        j = 0 ∧
                                          d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧
                                            q < d.workTapePos j + ↑(joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length then
                                      fieldsTape (cfgRecord s (MultiTapeTM.step c) (upd τ (MultiTapeTM.outputSymbol c)))
                                        (q - d.workTapePos j)
                                    else d.workTapes j q,
                                  workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output }) ∧
                            (¬Cfg.InWindow s (MultiTapeTM.step c) →
                              MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t =
                                { state := some no, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
                                  workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output })
exists_recordEqTM : ∀ (k : ℕ) (Q T : Type) [Fintype Q] [inst : DecidableEq Q] [Fintype T] [inst_2 : DecidableEq T],
  ∃ P x x R entry yes no C,
    yes ≠ no ∧
      ∀ {x : List (RecSym Q T)} (fs gs : List (List (RecSym Q T))),
        fs.length = k + 3 →
          gs.length = k + 3 →
            ∀ (d : Cfg 2 (RecSym Q T) P x),
              d.state = some entry →
                RecordAt d 0 fs →
                  RecordAt d 1 gs →
                    ∃ t ≤ C * ((joinFields fs).length + 1),
                      (∀ u < t,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some yes ∧ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some no) ∧
                        (∀ u ≤ t,
                            ∀ (j : Fin 2),
                              |(MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
                                ↑(C * ((joinFields fs).length + 1))) ∧
                          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t =
                            { state := some (if fs = gs then yes else no), inputPos := d.inputPos,
                              workTapes := d.workTapes, workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output }
@exists_recordTestTM : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
  (P : Option Q → T → Bool),
  ∃ P' x x R entry yes no C,
    yes ≠ no ∧
      ∀ {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) {y : List (RecSym Q T)} (d : Cfg 1 (RecSym Q T) P' y),
        d.state = some entry →
          RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ) →
            ∃ t ≤ C * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1),
              (∀ u < t, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some yes ∧ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some no) ∧
                (∀ u ≤ t,
                    ∀ (j : Fin 1),
                      |(MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
                        ↑(C * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1))) ∧
                  MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t =
                    { state := some (if P c.state τ = true then yes else no), inputPos := d.inputPos,
                      workTapes := d.workTapes, workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output }
FinTM.exists_inputCallTM : ∀ (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ),
  M.ComputesFunInTime f T →
    ∃ C entry exit c,
      0 < C.k ∧
        ∀ (x : List Bool),
          ∃ t ≤ c * (T x.length + x.length + (f x).length + 1),
            0 < t ∧
              (∀ (t' : ℕ),
                  0 < t' → t' < t → (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry fun x => []) t').state ≠ some exit) ∧
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry fun x => []) t = Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f x))
exists_inputSeekTM : ∃ S x x R entry exit C,
  ∀ {x : List Bool} (p : ℕ) (w : List Bool),
    Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) = p →
      p ≤ x.length + 1 →
        ∀ (d : Cfg 2 Bool S x),
          d.state = some entry →
            (∀ (q : ℤ), -1 ≤ q → q ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q) →
              (∀ (q : ℤ), d.workTapes 1 q = none) →
                ∃ t ≤ C * (w.length + ↑d.inputPos + p + 1),
                  (∀ u < t, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
                    (∀ u ≤ t,
                        ∀ (j : Fin 2),
                          |(MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ ↑(C * (w.length + 1))) ∧
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state = some exit ∧
                        ↑(MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).inputPos = p ∧
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
                            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
                              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).output = d.output

  (cfgRecord s c τ).length = k + 3

SweepPhase : Type

@copyTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase
@copyTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k),
  src ≠ dst →
    ∀ (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
      d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = src ∨ j = dst then
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                      Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@clearTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase
@clearTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),

      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
          { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
            workTapes := fun j q =>
              if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then none else d.workTapes j q,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@transferTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k),
  src ≠ dst →
    ∀ (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
      d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =

                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
incrementTM : (k : ℕ) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Bool FlagPhase
@incrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w v : List Bool),
  incFixed w = some v →
    ∀ (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x),
      d.state = some FlagPhase.run →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →

            (∀ t < 2 * (List.takeWhile id w).length + 2,

  incFixed w = none →
    ∀ (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x),
      d.state = some FlagPhase.run →

          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =

                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length false) (q - d.workTapePos j)
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ (b : Bool), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),

@compareTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq Symbol] → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Symbol FlagPhase
@compareTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k),
  fst ≠ snd →
    ∀ (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x),
      d.state = some FlagPhase.run →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑u.length → d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) →
          (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑v.length → d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) →
            ∃ δ ≤ min u.length v.length,
              MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * δ + 2) =
                  { state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))), inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
                    workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
                (∀ t < 2 * δ + 2, ∀ (b : Bool), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
                  ∀ (j : Fin k),
                    ∀ t ≤ 2 * δ + 2,
                      if j = fst ∨ j = snd then
                        (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                          Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑δ)
                      else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j

@skipTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)

      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (w.length + 1) =
          { state := some SeekPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ↑w.length + 1), output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < w.length + 1, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SeekPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ w.length + 1,
              if j = i then

              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j

@scanTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A)

          ∀ (j : Fin k),

              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j

@scanResult_fold : ∀ {A : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanFold δ) scanKeep a₀ w = (List.foldl δ a₀ w, w)
@scanResult_map : ∀ {A : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (f : Γ → Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanMap f) scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, List.map f w)
@scanResult_shiftRight : ∀ {B : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanShift get set) scanKeep b₀ w =
    ((List.map get w).getLast?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (b₀ :: List.map get w))
@scanResult_shiftLeft : ∀ {B : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult scanKeep (scanShift get set) b₀ w =
    ((List.map get w).head?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (List.map get w.tail ++ [b₀]))
@scanResult_carry : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanCarry top next) scanKeep true w =
    (w.all top,
      List.map next (List.takeWhile top w) ++ List.map next (List.take 1 (List.dropWhile top w)) ++
        List.drop 1 (List.dropWhile top w))
@embedEmitTM : {m k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → (Fin m ↪ Fin k) → MultiTapeTM m Symbol S → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S
@embedEmitCfg : {m k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} →
      {x : List Symbol} →
        (Fin m ↪ Fin k) → (Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) → (Fin k → ℤ) → List Symbol → Cfg m Symbol S x → Cfg k Symbol S x
@embedEmitTM_runFrom : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol)
  (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t = embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t)
@embedEmitTM_frame : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol)
  (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),
  (∀ j ∉ Set.range ⇑ι,
      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t).workTapes j = tapes j ∧
        (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t).workTapePos j = heads j) ∧
    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t).inputPos = (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).inputPos ∧
      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t).output = pre ++ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).output
@embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol)
  (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin m),
  MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t (ι i) = MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead c t i ∧
    MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t (ι i) = MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape c t i
@embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_frame : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol}
  (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
  (pre : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),
  ∀ j ∉ Set.range ⇑ι,
    MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t j = {heads j} ∧
      MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t j = 1
@embedEmitCfg_selected_tape : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (i : Fin m),
  (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c).workTapes (ι i) = c.workTapes i
@embedEmitCfg_selected_pos : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (i : Fin m),
  (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c).workTapePos (ι i) = c.workTapePos i
@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Symbol}
  (src : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (host : MultiTapeTM k Symbol H) (emb : S ↪ H) (good : S → Prop),
  (∀ (q : S),
      good q →
        ∀ (inp : Option Symbol) (work : Fin k → Option Symbol),
          host.tr (emb q) inp work = Action.mapState (⇑emb) (src.tr q inp work)) →
    ∀ (c : Cfg k Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),
      (∀ u < t, ∀ (q : S), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).state = some q → good q) →
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) c) t = Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t)
@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
  {Q : Set State},
  M.AgreeOn N Q →
    ∀ {input : List Symbol} (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (t : ℕ),
      (∀ u < t, ∀ (q : State), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).state = some q → q ∈ Q) →
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t = MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t
@seamCompTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {S₁ : Type u_1} →
    {S₂ : Type u_2} →
      {Symbol : Type u_3} →
        [DecidableEq S₁] → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁ → S₁ → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂ → S₂ → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (S₁ ⊕ S₂)
@seamCompTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂)
  {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {c₃ : Cfg k Symbol S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ},
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁ →
    c₁.state = some exit →
      (∀ t < T₁, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) →
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry) c₁) T₂ = c₃ →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) = Cfg.mapState Sum.inr c₃
@seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry q₂ : S₂)
  {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {c₃ : Cfg k Symbol S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ},
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁ →
    c₁.state = some exit →
      (∀ t < T₁, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) →
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry) c₁) T₂ = c₃ →
          c₃.state = some q₂ →
            (∀ t < T₂, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry) c₁) t).state ≠ some q₂) →
              ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr q₂)
@seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂)
  {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ},
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁ →
    c₁.state = some exit →
      (∀ t < T₁, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) →
        ∀ (i : Fin k),
          MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) i ⊆
            MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead c₀ T₁ i ∪
              MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry) c₁) T₂ i
@seamCompTM_runFrom_left : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂)
  {c : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T : ℕ},
  (∀ t < T, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).state ≠ some exit) →
    ∀ t ≤ T, MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c) t = Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t)
@seamCompTM₂ : {k : ℕ} →
  {S₁ : Type u_1} →
    {S₂ : Type u_2} →
      {Symbol : Type u_3} →
        {S₀ : Type u_4} →
          [DecidableEq S₀] →
            [DecidableEq S₁] →
              MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₀ →
                S₀ →
                  S₀ →
                    MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁ → S₁ → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂ → S₂ → MultiTapeTM k Symbol ((S₀ ⊕ S₁) ⊕ S₂)
@seamCompTM₂_run_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {S₀ : Type u_4} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₀] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S₁] (M₀ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₀) (e₁ e₂ : S₀),
  e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    ∀ (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (entry₁ : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry₂ : S₂)
      {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₀ x} {T₀ : ℕ},
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₀ = c₁ →
        (∀ t < T₀, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₁ ∧ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₂) →
          (c₁.state = some e₁ →
              ∀ (t : ℕ),
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀)) (T₀ + 1 + t) =
                  Cfg.mapState Sum.inl
                    (Cfg.mapState Sum.inr (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry₁) c₁) t))) ∧
            (c₁.state = some e₂ →
              ∀ (t : ℕ),
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀)) (T₀ + 1 + t) =
                  Cfg.mapState Sum.inr (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry₂) c₁) t))
@seamReleaseTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S → S → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (Unit ⊕ S)
@seamReleaseTM_firstReturn : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S)
  (anchor : S) {c c' : Cfg k Symbol S x} {T : ℕ},
  c.state = some anchor →
    0 < T →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T = c' →
        c'.state = some anchor →
          (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → t < T → (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).state ≠ some anchor) →
            MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => Sum.inl ()) c) T = Cfg.mapState Sum.inr c' ∧
              ∀ t < T, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => Sum.inl ()) c) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr anchor)
@seamReleaseTM_visitedByTapeHead : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol}
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (anchor : S) {c : Cfg k Symbol S x},
  c.state = some anchor →
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (i : Fin k),
      MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.mapState (fun x => Sum.inl ()) c) t i = MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead c t i
@decodeBool : {Γ : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq Γ] → (Bool ↪ Γ) → Γ → Option Bool
@decodeBool_apply : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Γ] (e : Bool ↪ Γ) (b : Bool), decodeBool e (e b) = some b
@Action.liftSymbols : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ : Type u_1} → {State : Type u_2} → (Bool ↪ Γ) → Action k Bool State → Action k Γ State
@Cfg.liftSymbols : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ : Type u_1} →
    {State : Type u_2} → (e : Bool ↪ Γ) → {x : List Bool} → Cfg k Bool State x → Cfg k Γ State (List.map (⇑e) x)
@MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ : Type u_1} → {State : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq Γ] → MultiTapeTM k Bool State → (Bool ↪ Γ) → MultiTapeTM k Γ State
@MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols_step : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq Γ]
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool State) (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool State x),
  MultiTapeTM.step (Cfg.liftSymbols e c) = Cfg.liftSymbols e (MultiTapeTM.step c)
@MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols_runFrom : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq Γ]
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool State) (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool State x) (t : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.liftSymbols e c) t = Cfg.liftSymbols e (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t)
@Cfg.liftSymbols_state : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {x : List Bool}
  (c : Cfg k Bool State x), (Cfg.liftSymbols e c).state = c.state
@Cfg.liftSymbols_workTapePos : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {x : List Bool}
  (c : Cfg k Bool State x), (Cfg.liftSymbols e c).workTapePos = c.workTapePos
@Cfg.liftSymbols_inputSymbol : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {x : List Bool}
  (c : Cfg k Bool State x), (Cfg.liftSymbols e c).inputSymbol = Option.map (⇑e) c.inputSymbol
@MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols_spaceUsed : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq Γ]
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool State) (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool State x) (t : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed (Cfg.liftSymbols e c) t = MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed c t
decrementTM : (k : ℕ) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Bool FlagPhase
@decrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w v : List Bool),
  decFixed w = some v →
    ∀ (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x),
      d.state = some FlagPhase.run →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * (List.takeWhile not w).length + 2) =
              { state := some (FlagPhase.done true), inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    FinTM.bufferTape v (q - d.workTapePos j)
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * (List.takeWhile not w).length + 2,
                ∀ (b : Bool), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * (List.takeWhile not w).length + 2,
                  if j = i then
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                      Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑(List.takeWhile not w).length)
                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@decrementTM_run_underflow_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w : List Bool),
  decFixed w = none →
    ∀ (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x),
      d.state = some FlagPhase.run →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some (FlagPhase.done false), inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length true) (q - d.workTapePos j)
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ (b : Bool), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = i then
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                      Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
decFixed : List Bool → Option (List Bool)
counterWord : List Bool → ℕ → List Bool
counterWord_length : ∀ (w : List Bool) (r : ℕ), (counterWord w r).length = w.length
counterWord_value : ∀ (w : List Bool),
  ∀ r ≤ Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w),
    Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat (counterWord w r)) = Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) - r
counterOverhead : List Bool → ℕ → ℕ
counterOverhead_le : ∀ (w : List Bool),
  counterOverhead w (Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) + 1) ≤
    4 * Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) + 2 * w.length + 2
counterOverhead_le_of_le : ∀ (w : List Bool),
  ∀ r ≤ Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w), counterOverhead w r ≤ 4 * r + 2 * w.length
CounterLoopState : Type → Type
counterLoopStateFintype : (S : Type) → [Fintype S] → Fintype (CounterLoopState S)
@counterLoopRedirect : {S : Type} → [DecidableEq S] → S → Option S → S → CounterLoopState S
@counterLoopTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type} → [DecidableEq S] → MultiTapeTM k Bool S → S → Option S → MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool (CounterLoopState S)
@counterLoopCfg : {k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type} →
    {x : List Bool} →
      Option (CounterLoopState S) → Cfg k Bool S x → (ℤ → Option Bool) → ℤ → Cfg (k + 1) Bool (CounterLoopState S) x
@counterLoopOrbit : {k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type} → {x : List Bool} → MultiTapeTM k Bool S → (Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ) → Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x
@counterLoopTM_run_done : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [inst : DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (a : S)
  (exit : Option S) (τ : Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
  (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
    ∀ (d : ℕ),
      Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) = d →
        (∀ r < d,
            (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r).state = some a ∧
              0 < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∧
                (∀ (u : ℕ),
                    0 < u →
                      u < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) →
                        ∃ s,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ a ∧ exit ≠ some s) ∧
                  (counterLoopOrbit M τ c (r + 1)).state = some a) →
          ∀ (T : ℕ),
            T = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range d, τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) + counterOverhead w (d + 1) →
              MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) T =
                  counterLoopCfg (some CounterLoopState.done) (counterLoopOrbit M τ c d)
                    (fun q => if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + ↑w.length then some true else ct q) cp ∧
                (∀ t < T,
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).state ≠
                        some CounterLoopState.done ∧
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                            t).state ≠
                        some CounterLoopState.escape) ∧
                  (∀ t ≤ T,
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                              t).workTapePos
                          (Fin.last k) ∈
                        Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + ↑w.length)) ∧
                    ∀ t ≤ T,
                      ∃ r u,
                        (r < d ∧ u ≤ τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∨ r = d ∧ u = 0) ∧
                          ∀ (j : Fin k),
                            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                    t).workTapePos
                                j.castSucc =
                              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).workTapePos j
@counterLoopTM_run_escape : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [inst : DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
  (a e : S),
  e ≠ a →
    ∀ (τ : Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
      (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
        ∀ r₀ < Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w),
          (∀ r ≤ r₀,
              (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r).state = some a ∧
                0 < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∧
                  ∀ (u : ℕ),
                    0 < u →
                      u < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) →
                        ∃ s, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ a ∧ s ≠ e) →
            (counterLoopOrbit M τ c (r₀ + 1)).state = some e →
              ∀ (T : ℕ),
                T = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (r₀ + 1), τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) + counterOverhead w (r₀ + 1) →
                  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) T =
                      counterLoopCfg (some CounterLoopState.escape) (counterLoopOrbit M τ c (r₀ + 1))
                        (fun q =>
                          if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + ↑w.length then FinTM.bufferTape (counterWord w (r₀ + 1)) (q - cp)
                          else ct q)
                        cp ∧
                    (∀ t < T,
                        (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                t).state ≠
                            some CounterLoopState.done ∧
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                t).state ≠
                            some CounterLoopState.escape) ∧
                      (∀ t ≤ T,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                  t).workTapePos
                              (Fin.last k) ∈
                            Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + ↑w.length)) ∧
                        ∀ t ≤ T,
                          ∃ r u,
                            (r ≤ r₀ ∧ u ≤ τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∨ r = r₀ + 1 ∧ u = 0) ∧
                              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom
                                        (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                        t).workTapePos
                                    j.castSucc =
                                  (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).workTapePos j
@counterLoop_time_le : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (τ : Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ)
  (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (w : List Bool) (d : ℕ),
  Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) = d →
    ∀ (B : ℕ),
      (∀ r < d, τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ≤ B) →
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range d, τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) + counterOverhead w (d + 1) ≤
          d * B + 4 * d + 2 * w.length + 2
@inputCopyTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase
@inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
  d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
    d.inputPos = 1 →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
          { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
            workTapes := fun j q =>
              if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑x.length then
                FinTM.bufferTape x (q - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j q,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑x.length)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@writeConstTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w₀ : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol (WritePhase w₀.length) x),
  d.state = some (WritePhase.wr 0) →
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w₀.length + 2) =
        { state := some WritePhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w₀.length then
              FinTM.bufferTape w₀ (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q,
          workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w₀.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some WritePhase.done) ∧
        ∀ (j : Fin k),
          ∀ t ≤ 2 * w₀.length + 2,
            if j = i then
              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w₀.length)
            else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
FinTM.exists_installCallTM : ∀ (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ),
  M.ComputesFunInTime f T →
    ∃ C entry exit c,
      0 < C.k ∧
        ∀ (x arg : List Bool),
          ∃ t ≤ c * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
            0 < t ∧
              (∀ (t' : ℕ),
                  0 < t' →
                    t' < t → (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t').state ≠ some exit) ∧
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t = Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg))
stateWord : (k : ℕ) → List Bool → Fin k → List Bool
@Cfg.ofWords : {k : ℕ} → {State : Type u_1} → {input : List Bool} → State → (Fin k → List Bool) → Cfg k Bool State input
@Cfg.ofWords_workTapes : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {input : List Bool} (q : State) (w : Fin k → List Bool)
  (i : Fin k), (Cfg.ofWords q w).workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (w i)
@FinTM.timed_rewind : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S)
  (dest : Option S),
  (∀ (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool),
      tm.tr start inp work = FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some scan)) →
    (∀ (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool),
        tm.tr scan inp work =
          match inp with
          | some val => FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some scan)
          | none => FinTM.controlAction SignType.pos dest) →
      ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool S x),
        c.state = some start →
          ∃ r ≤ ↑c.inputPos + 2,
            MultiTapeTM.runFrom c r =
              { state := dest, inputPos := 1, workTapes := c.workTapes, workTapePos := c.workTapePos,
                output := c.output }
@FinTM.rewind_scan : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S),
  (∀ (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool),
      tm.tr scan inp work =
        match inp with
        | some val => FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some scan)
        | none => FinTM.controlAction SignType.pos dest) →
    ∀ (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x),
      cfg.state = some scan →
        ↑cfg.inputPos ≤ x.length →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg (↑cfg.inputPos + 1) =
            { state := dest, inputPos := 1, workTapes := cfg.workTapes, workTapePos := cfg.workTapePos,
              output := cfg.output }
@FinTM.controlAction : {k : ℕ} → {S : Type} → SignType → Option S → Action k Bool S
@FinTM.controlAction_apply : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (m : SignType) (q : Option S),
  (FinTM.controlAction m q).apply cfg =
    { state := q, inputPos := moveInputPos cfg.inputPos m, workTapes := cfg.workTapes, workTapePos := cfg.workTapePos,
      output := cfg.output }
@FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val : ∀ {n : ℕ} (pos : Fin (n + 2)), ↑(moveInputPos pos SignType.neg) = ↑pos - 1

@FinTM.bufferTape_nil : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1}, FinTM.bufferTape [] = fun x => none

@FinTM.bufferTape_left : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} (w : List Symbol), FinTM.bufferTape w (-1) = none

@moveInputPos_neg_of_ne_left : ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)), p ≠ 0 → moveInputPos p SignType.neg = ⟨↑p - 1, ⋯⟩

    {State : Type u_2} →

@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {k' : ℕ} {State' : Type u_3}
  {input input' : List Symbol} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {tm' : MultiTapeTM k' Symbol State'}
  (f : Cfg k Symbol State input → Cfg k' Symbol State' input'),

    ∀ (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (n : ℕ), MultiTapeTM.runFrom (f cfg) n = f (MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg n)
@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}

@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step' : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}
  {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} {t : ℕ},

      {input : List Symbol} → {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} → Cfg k Symbol State input → ℕ → Fin k → Finset ℤ

@phaseHostTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ I : Type} →
    {Ph : I → Type} →
      ((i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) →
        (i : I) × Ph i → ((i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) → MultiTapeTM k Γ ((i : I) × Ph i)
@phaseHostTM_run : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : (i : I) × Ph i)
  (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ} (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T = c' →
    ∀ (s' : Ph i),
      c'.state = some s' →
        ∀ (q' : (i : I) × Ph i),
          red i s' = some q' →
            (∀ u < T, ∀ (s : Ph i), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) →
              (∀ u ≤ T,
                  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) u =
                    Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u)) ∧
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) (T + 1) = Cfg.mapState (fun x => q') c'
@counter_cfg_eq : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (q : Option (CounterLoopState S)) (c : Cfg k Bool S x)
  (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
  counterLoopCfg q c ct cp =
    { state := q, inputPos := c.inputPos,
      workTapes := fun i => Fin.lastCases (motive := fun x => ℤ → Option Bool) ct c.workTapes i,
      workTapePos := fun i => Fin.lastCases cp c.workTapePos i, output := c.output }
@FinTM.rewind_scan_heads : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S)
  (dest : Option S),
  (∀ (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool),
      tm.tr scan inp work =
        match inp with
        | some val => FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some scan)
        | none => FinTM.controlAction SignType.pos dest) →
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x),
      cfg.state = some scan →
        ↑cfg.inputPos = j → j ≤ x.length → ∀ u ≤ j + 1, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg u).workTapePos = cfg.workTapePos
@FinTM.rewind_heads : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S)
  (dest : Option S),
  (∀ (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool),
      tm.tr start inp work = FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some scan)) →
    (∀ (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool),
        tm.tr scan inp work =
          match inp with
          | some val => FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some scan)
          | none => FinTM.controlAction SignType.pos dest) →
      ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool S x),
        c.state = some start →
          ∃ r ≤ ↑c.inputPos + 2,
            MultiTapeTM.runFrom c r =
                { state := dest, inputPos := 1, workTapes := c.workTapes, workTapePos := c.workTapePos,

@joinFields_cons_cons : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} (u v : List Γ) (fs : List (List Γ)),
  joinFields (u :: v :: fs) = List.map some u ++ none :: joinFields (v :: fs)
@fieldsTape_cons_shift : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} (u v : List Γ) (fs : List (List Γ)) (z : ℤ),
  -1 ≤ z → fieldsTape (u :: v :: fs) (↑u.length + 1 + z) = fieldsTape (v :: fs) z
@fieldOffset_succ : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} (fs : List (List Γ)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < fs.length),
  fieldOffset fs (j + 1) = fieldOffset fs j + (fs[j].length + 1)
@fieldOffset_cons_succ : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} (u : List Γ) (fs : List (List Γ)) (j : ℕ),

@step_of_tapeAction_move : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k) (inp m : SignType),
  c.state = some q →
    M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp none m q' →
      MultiTapeTM.step c =
        { state := some q', inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp, workTapes := c.workTapes,
          workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + ↑m), output := c.output }
@step_of_tapeAction_write : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k) (inp : SignType)
  (s : Option Symbol) (m : SignType),
  c.state = some q →
    M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp (some s) m q' →
      MultiTapeTM.step c =
        { state := some q', inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp,
          workTapes := Function.update c.workTapes i (Function.update (c.workTapes i) (c.workTapePos i) s),
          workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + ↑m), output := c.output }
@step_of_inputMoveAction : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (inp : SignType),
  c.state = some q →
    M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = inputMoveAction inp q' →
      MultiTapeTM.step c =
        { state := some q', inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp, workTapes := c.workTapes,
          workTapePos := c.workTapePos, output := c.output }

  decodeBool e γ = some b → γ = e b
@FinTM.bufferTape_map : ∀ {Γ : Type} (e : Bool ↪ Γ) (w : List Bool) (p : ℤ),
  FinTM.bufferTape (List.map (⇑e) w) p = Option.map (⇑e) (FinTM.bufferTape w p)

@Cfg.liftOver : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ Q : Type} →
    [DecidableEq Γ] →
      (Bool ↪ Γ) → {x : List Γ} → {x' : List Bool} → x'.length = x.length → Cfg k Γ Q x → Cfg k Bool Q x' → Cfg k Γ Q x
@MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols_step_over : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Γ] (e : Bool ↪ Γ)
  (N : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q),
  (∀ (q : Q) (inp inp' : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool), N.tr q inp work = N.tr q inp' work) →
    (∀ (q : Q) (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool) (j : Fin k),
        ((N.tr q inp work).workTapes j).1 ≠ some none) →
      ∀ {x : List Γ} {x' : List Bool} (hx : x'.length = x.length) (D : Cfg k Γ Q x) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x'),
        MultiTapeTM.step (Cfg.liftOver e hx D c) = Cfg.liftOver e hx D (MultiTapeTM.step c)
@MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols_runFrom_over : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Γ] (e : Bool ↪ Γ)
  (N : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q),
  (∀ (q : Q) (inp inp' : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool), N.tr q inp work = N.tr q inp' work) →
    (∀ (q : Q) (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool) (j : Fin k),
        ((N.tr q inp work).workTapes j).1 ≠ some none) →
      ∀ {x : List Γ} {x' : List Bool} (hx : x'.length = x.length) (D : Cfg k Γ Q x) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x') (t : ℕ),
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.liftOver e hx D c) t = Cfg.liftOver e hx D (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t)
@Cfg.decodeSymbols : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ Q : Type} → [DecidableEq Γ] → (Bool ↪ Γ) → {x : List Γ} → Cfg k Γ Q x → Cfg k Bool Q (List.map (fun x => false) x)
@Cfg.liftOver_decodeSymbols : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Γ] (e : Bool ↪ Γ) {x : List Γ}
  (D : Cfg k Γ Q x), Cfg.liftOver e ⋯ D (Cfg.decodeSymbols e D) = D

@cfgRecord_inj : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) {c d : Cfg k Bool Q x} {τ τ' : T},
  Cfg.InWindow s c →
    Cfg.InWindow s d →
      (cfgRecord s c τ = cfgRecord s d τ' ↔
        (c.state = d.state ∧ c.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ c.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ c.workTapePos = d.workTapePos) ∧
          τ = τ')
@recordValid_iff : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} (n s : ℕ) (fs : List (List (RecSym Q T))),
  RecordValid k n s Q T fs ↔
    fs.length = k + 3 ∧
      (∃ q, fs[0]? = some [RecSym.st q]) ∧
        (∃ v ≤ n + 1, fs[1]? = some (List.map RecSym.digit (binDigits (posWidth n) v))) ∧
          (∀ (i : Fin k),
              ∃ cs,
                ∃ m < 2 * s + 1,
                  fs[↑i + 2]? =
                    some (List.map (fun j => RecSym.cell (cs j) (decide (j = m))) (List.range (2 * s + 1)))) ∧
            ∃ τ, fs[k + 2]? = some [RecSym.tag τ]
@exists_recordStepTM : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T),
  (∀ (τ : T), upd τ none = τ) →
    ∃ K P x x R entry yes no C,
      yes ≠ no ∧
        ∀ {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T),
          Cfg.InWindow s c →
            ∀ (d : Cfg (K + 1) (RecSym Q T) P (List.map (⇑(RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) x)),
              d.state = some entry →
                RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ) →
                  (∀ (j : Fin (K + 1)), j ≠ 0 → ∀ (p : ℤ), d.workTapes j p = none) →
                    ∃ t ≤ C * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + x.length + 1),
                      (∀ u < t,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some yes ∧ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some no) ∧
                        (∀ u ≤ t,
                            ∀ (j : Fin (K + 1)),
                              |(MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
                                ↑(C * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1))) ∧
                          (Cfg.InWindow s (MultiTapeTM.step c) →
                              MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t =
                                { state := some yes, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                                  workTapes := fun j q =>
                                    if
                                        j = 0 ∧
                                          d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧
                                            q < d.workTapePos j + ↑(joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length then
                                      fieldsTape (cfgRecord s (MultiTapeTM.step c) (upd τ (MultiTapeTM.outputSymbol c)))
                                        (q - d.workTapePos j)

                                  workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output }) ∧
                            (¬Cfg.InWindow s (MultiTapeTM.step c) →

                                { state := some no, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
                                  workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output })

exists_inputSeekTM : ∃ S x x R entry exit C,
  ∀ {x : List Bool} (p : ℕ) (w : List Bool),
    Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) = p →
      p ≤ x.length + 1 →
        ∀ (d : Cfg 2 Bool S x),
          d.state = some entry →
            (∀ (q : ℤ), -1 ≤ q → q ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q) →
              (∀ (q : ℤ), d.workTapes 1 q = none) →
                ∃ t ≤ C * (w.length + ↑d.inputPos + p + 1),
                  (∀ u < t, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
                    (∀ u ≤ t,
                        ∀ (j : Fin 2),
                          |(MultiTapeTM.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ ↑(C * (w.length + 1))) ∧
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state = some exit ∧
                        ↑(MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).inputPos = p ∧
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
                            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
                              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).output = d.output

                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
